items.title: 馬斯克難攻印度市場 Starlink受阻將如何影響SpaceX？
items.title_en: Musk Finds Indian Market Hard to Crack; How Will Starlink Setbacks Affect SpaceX?
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周四(8日)走低，投資人正在評估Starlink在印度市場擴張所面臨的阻礙。
馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下火箭與人工智慧公司SpaceX股價下跌4.2%，收在160.57美元。標普500指數下跌0.5%，道瓊工業指數則上漲0.1%。SpaceX周四股價下跌前，才剛經歷幾個強勁的交易日，此前10月1日收盤時仍低於150美元。
周四的股價走勢，源自馬斯克周三在社群平台X發表的一則貼文。他指控「某些寡頭」試圖維持「對印度人民的壟斷性控制」。
馬斯克表示，印度當地網路服務業者，包括Reliance Jio與Bharti Airtel，正讓Starlink難以在該國推出服務。
Starlink是SpaceX的衛星寬頻服務，目前已在超過160個國家提供服務。截至第二季末，Starlink約有1,200萬名訂戶。
然而，Starlink要運作仍需要無線電頻譜來傳送訊號。就像同一地區的兩個廣播電台無法使用相同頻率進行廣播一樣，無線數據服務商也需要各自的頻譜來傳輸資訊。目前Starlink仍在等待印度核發衛星頻譜。
對投資人而言，監管延誤或競爭對手網路業者採取的行動，都可能成為SpaceX成長的潛在阻力。
預計Starlink第三季營收將達約48億美元，高於第二季的43億美元。
德意志銀行分析師Edison Yu近期在報告中寫道，「截至9月底，全球消費者訂戶數預估達1,350萬，9月單月淨新增訂戶超過37萬。」
他表示，「北美市場以550萬名訂戶居首，占整體訂戶數的41%，9月單月新增12.6萬名訂戶。」
就目前而言，即使沒有印度市場，SpaceX仍擁有相當大的成長空間。
投資人將在幾周後SpaceX公布第三季財報時，取得更準確的Starlink訂戶數量與業務最新進展。預計SpaceX單季AI業務營收將首次超越Starlink。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that SpaceX (SPCX-US) shares fell on Thursday the 8th as investors assess the obstacles Starlink faces in expanding into the Indian market.

Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company SpaceX saw its stock drop 4.2% to $160.57. The S&P 500 fell 0.5% while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.1%. The decline came after a few strong trading days, with the stock still below $150 at the close on Oct. 1.

The Thursday price move was triggered by a post Musk made on the social platform X on Wednesday, in which he accused “certain oligarchs” of trying to maintain “monopolistic control over the Indian people.”
Musk said that local Indian internet service providers, including Reliance Jio and Bharti Airtel, are making it difficult for Starlink to launch services in the country.
Starlink is SpaceX’s satellite broadband service, now operating in more than 160 countries. By the end of Q2 it had roughly 12 million subscribers.

However, Starlink still needs radio spectrum to transmit signals. Just as two radio stations in the same area cannot use the same frequency, broadband providers need separate spectrum allocations. Starlink is still waiting for India to allocate satellite spectrum.
For investors, regulatory delays or actions taken by competing network operators could become potential headwinds to SpaceX’s growth.
Starlink’s Q3 revenue is projected to reach about $4.8 billion, up from $4.3 billion in Q2.

Deutsche Bank analyst Edison Yu wrote in a recent note that global consumer subscriber numbers are estimated at 13.5 million by the end of September, with more than 370,000 net new subscribers added in September alone.
He added that the North American market leads with 5.5 million subscribers, accounting for 41% of the total, and added 126,000 new subscribers in September.
At present, even without the Indian market, SpaceX still has substantial growth potential.

Investors will get a clearer picture of Starlink’s subscriber count and business progress when SpaceX releases its Q3 earnings in a few weeks, with AI revenue expected to surpass Starlink’s for the first time in a single quarter.

items.title: 西南航空傳考慮採購數十架波音787 長程國際布局最快3年啟動
items.title_en: Southwest Airlines Considers Purchasing Dozens of Boeing 787s for Long-Haul International Expansion Within Three Years
paras: 美國廉價航空公司西南航空 (Southwest Airlines) (LUV-US) 正評估採購波音 (BA-US) 787夢幻客機 (Dreamliner)，作為拓展長程國際航線的首款廣體客機。3名知情人士透露，西南航空正考慮在未來約3年內推出長程國際航班，並研究透過租賃公司或二手飛機市場取得客機，以縮短機隊部署時間。不過，目前尚未做出最終機型決定，相關計畫仍須經公司董事會審議。
知情人士表示，西南航空曾考慮引進數十架787客機，但目前尚不清楚公司考慮的是哪一種787機型，也無法確認是否已經洽談或簽訂租賃安排。西南航空去年成立機隊監督委員會，協助監督機隊採購策略，最終機型選擇仍將由董事會決定。
西南航空財務長Tom Doxey今年9月曾表示，長程國際航線是公司正在評估的多項發展選項之一，但當時並未宣布任何決策。公司此次也未直接回應是否考慮787，僅表示目前沒有即將公布的機隊計畫消息。波音則將相關問題轉交西南航空回應，歐洲飛機製造商空中巴士 (Airbus, AIR-FR) 表示，不評論與航空公司的洽談內容。
若西南航空決定採用787，將代表公司機隊策略進入新階段。目前西南航空全數使用波音737系列窄體客機，尚未營運廣體客機。引進787不僅可讓公司開闢更長程的國際航線，也將使其與美國大型航空公司在跨洲航線市場直接競爭。
西南航空近年正逐步調整產品與營運策略，以吸引願意支付較高票價的旅客。公司已推出指定座位及額外腿部空間座位，並宣布計畫設立機場貴賓室及推出高端信用卡產品，希望擴大高收益客群，強化常客獎勵計畫Rapid Rewards及聯名信用卡業務。
執行長Bob Jordan先前表示，西南航空並不需要建立與達美航空 (DAL-US)、聯合航空 (UAL-US) 或美國航空 (AAL-US) 規模相當的長程國際網絡。今年5月，他指出，約8至12個長程目的地，就可能涵蓋多數西南航空客戶希望前往的地點。這顯示公司目前考慮的是有選擇性的長程擴張，而非全面複製大型航空公司的全球航線網絡。
在機型選擇方面，空中巴士也積極爭取西南航空的未來訂單。知情人士表示，空中巴士A321XLR與A330neo都可能滿足公司的部分長程需求，較小型的A220則被推介用於其他航線布局。不過，若選擇空中巴士，西南航空將必須打破目前全波音機隊的配置，增加新的飛機製造商與機型。
相較之下，787在目前討論中似乎更具優勢。西南航空飛行員工會主席Jody Reven近期在工會播客節目中透露，公司曾討論「大型客機」與「長程窄體客機」兩種方向，顯示航空公司仍在評估不同的機隊發展方案。
飛機交付時程將是決定長程航線何時啟動的重要因素。知情人士指出，西南航空討論的長程擴張時間表約為3年，但波音787目前的供應相當緊張。波音已表示，787客機的訂單交付時段已排滿至本世紀末，這可能限制西南航空直接訂購新機後投入營運的速度。
為了加快啟動長程航線，西南航空已研究向飛機租賃公司取得787，或從二手飛機市場購入客機，作為初期機隊的一部分。不過，目前尚無已確定的租賃或採購安排。
引進787也將帶來新的營運挑戰。西南航空過去已表示，新增機型需要建立相應的維修及訓練制度，取得監管機關批准，並與工會協商薪酬及工作規則。廣體客機的營運方式與現有737機隊不同，相關準備工作可能增加成本與執行複雜度。
西南航空若最終採用787，將是公司從以美國國內及短中程航線為主的營運模式，進一步拓展至長程國際市場的重要轉變。後續仍須觀察董事會決策、飛機供應與取得時程，以及公司是否能在不大幅增加營運複雜度的情況下，透過有限數量的長程目的地擴大收入來源。
paras_en: Southwest Airlines (LUV-US), the U.S. low‑cost carrier, is evaluating the purchase of Boeing (BA-US) 787 Dreamliners as its first wide‑body aircraft to support a long‑haul international network. Three sources said Southwest is looking at launching long‑haul international routes in roughly three years and is studying leasing or second‑hand markets to acquire aircraft faster, though no final type decision has been made and the plan still requires board approval.

The sources said Southwest has considered acquiring dozens of 787s, but it is unclear which 787 variant is being contemplated and whether any lease negotiations or agreements have been reached. Southwest set up a fleet oversight committee last year to monitor its acquisition strategy, with the ultimate aircraft choice still to be decided by the board.

Chief Financial Officer Tom Doxey told investors in September that long‑haul international routes are one of several options under review, but no decision was announced at the time. Southwest did not directly comment on whether it is considering the 787, saying there are no fleet announcements pending. Boeing redirected related questions back to Southwest, while Airbus (AIR-FR) declined to comment on any airline talks.

If Southwest adopts the 787, it would mark a new phase in its fleet strategy. The airline currently operates an all‑Boeing 737 narrow‑body fleet and has never flown a wide‑body. Adding the 787 would enable longer international routes and put Southwest in direct competition with the major U.S. carriers on intercontinental markets.

Southwest has been gradually adjusting its product and operations to attract higher‑fare passengers. It has introduced assigned seating and extra‑legroom seats, announced plans for airport lounges and premium credit‑card products, and aims to grow high‑yield customers while strengthening its Rapid Rewards loyalty program and co‑branded card business.

CEO Bob Jordan previously said Southwest does not need to build a long‑haul network as large as Delta (DAL-US), United (UAL-US) or American (AAL-US). In May he noted that about eight to twelve long‑haul destinations could cover most of Southwest’s customers’ desired locations, indicating a selective rather than a full‑scale global expansion.

In terms of aircraft choice, Airbus is also courting Southwest’s future orders. Sources said the A321XLR and A330neo could meet parts of the airline’s long‑haul needs, while the smaller A220 is being pitched for other route structures. Choosing Airbus would require Southwest to break its all‑Boeing fleet composition and add a new manufacturer.

By contrast, the 787 appears to have an edge in current discussions. Southwest pilots’ union chair Jody Reven recently revealed on a union podcast that the airline has debated both “large aircraft” and “long‑haul narrow‑body” options, showing that multiple fleet development paths are still being weighed.

Aircraft delivery timelines will be a key factor in when long‑haul routes can launch. Sources said Southwest’s expansion timeline is about three years, but Boeing’s 787 supply is tight. Boeing has indicated its 787 delivery slots are filled through the end of the century, which could limit how quickly Southwest could put new jets into service after a direct purchase.

To accelerate the start of long‑haul service, Southwest has looked at obtaining 787s from leasing firms or buying used aircraft as an initial fleet component. However, no lease or purchase agreements have been confirmed yet.

Introducing the 787 would also bring new operational challenges. Southwest has previously said that adding a new type requires building maintenance and training programs, obtaining regulator approval, and negotiating union pay and work rules. Operating a wide‑body differs from its existing 737 fleet and could raise costs and complexity.

If Southwest ultimately adopts the 787, it would represent a major shift from a domestic, short‑ to medium‑haul model to a long‑haul international focus. Future developments will depend on board decisions, aircraft availability and acquisition timing, and whether the airline can expand revenue with a limited number of long‑haul destinations without substantially increasing operational complexity.

items.title: 賣了也沒賺！記憶體漲到三星也吃不消 手機第四季最高減產30%
items.title_en: No Profit Even When Sold! Memory Prices Soaring Beyond Samsung’s Capacity, Q4 Smartphone Production Cut Up to 30%
paras: 南韓媒體MoneyToday報導，三星電子(005930KS) 行動體驗（MX）部門已開始削減今年第四季產量，預計減幅最高達30%。此舉被解讀為因應假期旺季期間，記憶體價格大幅上漲，導致營業利益率惡化。
據多位資訊通訊（IT）產業消息人士透露，三星電子行動部門近期已要求合作夥伴將產品供應量減少20%至30%。因此，三星電子第四季智慧型手機產量預估將減少最多30%。
業界人士指出，記憶體與半導體成本上升，已讓部分手機陷入「賣一台虧一台」的困境。成本壓力加上傳統淡季，三星全年手機出貨量恐降至2億支出頭。
第四季供應量擬砍兩至三成
消息人士透露，三星此次縮減供應的幅度，明顯超出市場原先預期。市場研究機構IDC先前估計，三星第四季智慧型手機產量約為5,200萬支，較第三季減少約12%，但三星內部實際要求的削減幅度更大。
三星今年原本寄望Galaxy Z Fold8等新品熱銷，帶動全年出貨量達到約2.7億支。如今第四季供應量被曝將削減兩至三成，全年出貨目標也面臨下修壓力。
一名IT產業知情人士表示，記憶體與其他半導體價格上漲，已使三星部分智慧型手機銷售無利可圖。減產是公司維護整體獲利水準的主動措施，也反映手機業務承受的成本壓力。
手機記憶體一年漲175%
這波減產的主要原因，是智慧型手機使用的記憶體價格急劇攀升。
根據半導體市場研究機構TrendForce資料，今年第二季，12GB規格的手機用低功耗DRAM（LPDDR5X）價格介於145至146美元，較一年前大漲175%。第三季價格預估將再上漲約20%，最高可能觸及180美元。
價格上漲背後，是AI產業快速擴張帶來的記憶體需求。供應轉向利潤較高的AI相關產品，導致智慧型手機用記憶體供應吃緊，採購成本持續走高。
對三星手機業務而言，記憶體價格接連上漲，正侵蝕產品獲利。即使新品銷售帶動出貨，成本增加仍使部分產品面臨虧損，也促使公司透過減少供應量，維護整體利潤。
新機上市前觀望 第四季需求轉淡
除了零組件成本，季節性需求也是三星選擇在第四季減產的重要背景。
三星通常在每年1月至2月推出新品。隨著發表時間接近，部分消費者會延後購機，等待新款上市，使現有產品銷售放緩。
此外，集中帶動購機需求的畢業季與開學季，均落在第一季，第四季向來是三星智慧型手機銷售的相對淡季。當需求轉淡，又碰上記憶體成本居高不下，手機業務獲利壓力進一步加重。
此次削減供應量，反映三星在淡季需求與成本上升的雙重壓力下，選擇收縮生產規模，優先維護獲利水準。
全年出貨目標承壓 手機部門恐虧損
從全年出貨來看，第四季大幅減產，將衝擊三星原先設定的規模目標。
IDC資料顯示，三星今年第一季與第二季智慧型手機出貨量，分別為6,240萬支與6,270萬支，第三季預估約5,900萬支。
若第四季供應量按最大幅度削減，全年出貨量預計將降至2億支出頭，與原先約2.7億支的目標出現明顯落差。
手機部門的獲利表現也受到市場關注。檔案援引金融資訊機構FnGuide資料指出，市場已彙整三星第三季整體營業利益預估，但另有券商預測，MX部門可能出現營業虧損。
記憶體成本攀升，使三星手機業務面臨出貨與獲利的雙重壓力。第四季供應縮減幅度、全年出貨量，以及MX部門能否維持獲利，成為這波減產消息的主要焦點。
paras_en: South Korean media MoneyToday reported that Samsung Electronics (005930KS) Mobile Experience (MX) division has begun cutting its production for the fourth quarter of this year, with reductions of up to 30%. The move is seen as a response to a sharp rise in memory prices during the holiday peak season, which has hurt operating margins.

According to several IT‑industry sources, Samsung’s mobile division has recently asked its partners to lower product supply by 20% to 30%. As a result, Samsung’s fourth‑quarter smartphone output is expected to fall by as much as 30%.

Industry insiders note that rising memory and semiconductor costs have pushed some phones into a “lose money on every unit sold” situation. The cost pressure, combined with the traditional off‑season, could see Samsung’s total annual shipments dip to just over 200 million units.
Q4 supply slated to be cut by 20‑30%

Sources say Samsung’s supply cut this time far exceeds market expectations. Research firm IDC previously estimated Samsung’s Q4 smartphone production at about 52 million units, roughly a 12% drop from Q3, but Samsung’s internal reduction request is even larger.

Samsung had hoped this year that new models such as the Galaxy Z Fold 8 would drive sales to around 270 million units for the full year. With the Q4 supply now reported to be cut by 20‑30%, the annual shipment target is under pressure to be revised downward.

An IT‑industry insider said that the surge in memory and other semiconductor prices has made sales of some Samsung smartphones unprofitable. The cutback is a proactive step to protect overall profitability and reflects the cost pressure on the handset business.
Phone memory prices up 175% in a year
The main driver of the cutback is the sharp rise in memory prices used in smartphones.

According to semiconductor market research firm TrendForce, in Q2 this year the price of 12 GB low‑power DRAM (LPDDR5X) for phones ranged between $145 and $146, a 175% increase from a year earlier. Prices are expected to rise another ~20% in Q3, potentially reaching $180 at the high end.

The price surge is fueled by rapid AI industry expansion, which has boosted memory demand. Suppliers are shifting to higher‑margin AI‑related products, tightening supply for smartphone memory and pushing procurement costs higher.

For Samsung’s handset business, the consecutive memory price hikes are eroding product margins. Even if new‑model sales boost shipments, higher costs are making some models loss‑making, prompting the company to curb supply to protect overall profit.
Consumers wait for new releases, dampening Q4 demand
Beyond component costs, seasonal demand is another key factor behind Samsung’s decision to cut production in Q4.

Samsung typically launches new models between January and February each year. As the launch date approaches, some consumers postpone purchases to wait for the new devices, slowing sales of existing models.

Moreover, the graduation and back‑to‑school periods that normally drive phone purchases fall in Q1, making Q4 a relative off‑season for Samsung’s smartphones. When demand wanes and memory costs stay high, profit pressure on the handset business intensifies.
The supply reduction reflects Samsung’s choice to shrink production under the dual pressure of weak seasonal demand and rising costs, prioritising profit preservation.
Annual shipment target under pressure, handset division may incur losses
Looking at the full‑year shipments, a large Q4 cut will hit Samsung’s originally set volume target.
IDC data show Samsung shipped 62.4 million smartphones in Q1 and 62.7 million in Q2 of this year, with Q3 estimated at about 59 million units.
If Q4 supply is cut at the maximum rate, total annual shipments are projected to fall to just over 200 million units, a clear gap from the original ~270 million‑unit goal.

The handset division’s profit performance is also drawing market attention. Data from financial information provider FnGuide indicate that the market has compiled Samsung’s Q3 overall operating profit estimate, but some brokerages forecast that the MX division could post an operating loss.

Rising memory costs are putting Samsung’s handset business under dual pressure of shipment volume and profitability. The extent of the Q4 supply cut, the full‑year shipment outlook, and whether the MX division can maintain profit are the main focus of this production‑cut news.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉權衡Fed利率前景 黃金從兩個月低點反彈
items.title_en: <Precious Metals After-Hours> Weighing Fed Rate Outlook, Gold Bounces from Two-Month Low
paras: 黃金周四(8日)從前日觸及的兩個月低點反彈，投資人正在評估聯準會(Fed)充滿不確定性的利率前景，以及日益上升的美國債務水準。

黃金現貨上漲0.4%，報每盎司4126.78美元，周三曾因美元和美債殖利率雙雙上揚，而觸及8月5日以來最低。
美國黃金期貨收高0.4%，報每盎司4157美元。


美元和美債殖利率連續第二日盤旋高檔。WisdomTree大宗商品策略師Nitesh Shah表示：「殖利率居高不下，似乎凸顯市場對高負債水準的憂慮正在擴大。如果債務持續攀升，那麼作為法定貨幣與政府資產對立面的黃金，可能更受青睞。」
聯準會(Fed)官員上個月對於升息的理由意見分歧，會議紀錄顯示，部分官員認為，升息有助於抑制能源及其他價格衝擊的影響。立場更偏鷹派的核心官員則認為，有必要升息以防範需求帶動的通膨升溫。
Shah補充說：「會議紀錄凸顯，Fed並沒有預先確定的政策路徑，這也使黃金市場的波動性略為升高。」
Fed理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，Fed可能還需要進一步升息，但他也指出，升息步調具有「彈性」，並未排除10月暫停升息的可能性。
根據芝商所(CME)的FedWatch工具，交易員認為Fed 10月升息的機率為17%，但市場已反映12月升息的機率高達81%。當利率走高，會降低不孳息黃金的吸引力。
地緣政治方面，消息人士指出，伊朗發出新的警告，揚言封鎖未經其授權的航線後，油輪試圖經由荷姆茲海峽運送重要貨物時，面臨的攻擊與脅迫風險正在升高。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀下跌1.9%，報每盎司58.98美元。
現貨白金上揚0.1%，報每盎司1637.41美元。
現貨鈀金上漲0.1%，報每盎司1126美元。
paras_en: Gold on Thursday (the 8th) rebounded from the two‑month low it hit the day before, as investors assess the Fed’s uncertain rate outlook and the rising level of U.S. debt.

Spot gold rose 0.4% to $4,126.78 per ounce. It had fallen to its lowest since August 5 on Wednesday as the dollar and U.S. Treasury yields both rose. U.S. gold futures were up 0.4% at $4,157 per ounce. The dollar and Treasury yields hovered at elevated levels for a second straight day. Commodity strategist Nitesh Shah of WisdomTree said: “Persistently high yields seem to underscore growing market worries about high debt levels. If debt keeps climbing, gold – the counter‑weight to fiat currency and government assets – could become more attractive.”

Fed officials last month were split on the rationale for further rate hikes, with the meeting minutes showing some members believing hikes help curb the impact of energy and other price shocks, while more hawkish core members argued hikes are needed to guard against demand‑driven inflationary pressure.
Shah added: “The minutes highlight that the Fed does not have a pre‑determined policy path, which also adds a bit of volatility to the gold market.”
Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that the Fed may still need to raise rates further, but he noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible” and did not rule out a pause in October.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, traders see a 17% probability of an October rate hike, while the market is pricing an 81% chance of a hike in December. Higher rates tend to reduce the appeal of non‑yield‑bearing gold.

Geopolitically, sources said Iran issued a new warning, threatening to block unauthorised shipping lanes, and that oil tankers attempting to transit the Hormuz Strait with important cargo face heightened risk of attack and coercion.
Other precious‑metal trades: Spot silver fell 1.9% to $58.98 per ounce. Spot platinum rose 0.1% to $1,637.41 per ounce. Spot palladium rose 0.1% to $1,126 per ounce.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉油價大漲逾4%！中東戰事升溫、颶風威脅美國供應
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: Oil Prices Surge Over 4% as Middle East Conflict Escalates and Hurricane Threatens U.S. Supply
paras: 國際油價周四(8日)大漲約4%, 中東戰事再度升溫及美國墨西哥灣颶風伊賽亞斯(Isaias)威脅能源供應, 成為推升油價的兩大因素。布蘭特原油 (Brent)期貨收盤上漲4.08美元, 漲幅4.1%, 報每桶104.28美元; 美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨上漲3.21美元, 漲幅3.6%, 收在每桶91.49美元。盤中兩大指標油價一度都上漲逾5美元, Brent更觸及9月29日以來最高水準。
油價盤中漲幅隨後收斂, 主因美國總統川普表示, 美國與伊朗正進行具建設性的對話, 並承諾在11月3日美國期中選舉前不會攻擊伊朗。市場原先擔憂美國可能對伊朗發動新一輪軍事打擊, 加上颶風預計周五登陸美國墨西哥灣沿岸, 使原油供應中斷風險升高。
伊朗塔斯尼姆通訊社報導, 伊朗外交部長阿拉奇表示, 德黑蘭正在審視美國對其提案的回應, 該提案希望在7天內重新開放荷姆茲海峽, 伊朗預計數日內作出回覆。不過, 美國周四仍宣布對伊朗實施新一輪制裁, 針對涉及運輸伊朗原油、石油產品及石化產品的人士、網絡與17艘船舶, 以進一步加大對德黑蘭的經濟壓力。
中東航運安全持續惡化, 也令市場對供應前景保持警戒。伊朗戰事進入第8個月, 波斯灣及荷姆茲海峽的商船運輸威脅在10月升高。戰爭爆發前, 經由荷姆茲海峽運輸的石油與燃料約占全球總量20%; 即使波斯灣產油國增加出口, 上周通過海峽的油輪遇襲次數仍升至戰爭爆發以來最高水準。
MST Marquee能源主管Saul Kavonic表示, 伊朗攻擊船舶的頻率已升至戰爭開始以來最高點, 且可能進一步增加。航運風險若持續升高, 即使產油國提高出口, 原油及成品油仍可能因運輸受阻而無法順利送達市場。

此外, 法國與沙烏地阿拉伯正研究運用法國軍事資產保護沙烏地延布(Yanbu)石油出口碼頭的多種方案。法國武裝部隊總參謀長Fabien Mandon周四表示, 雙方正在評估相關選項。敘利亞方面也在考慮是否向重要盟友沙烏地阿拉伯提供軍事援助, 協助其應對葉門境內獲伊朗支持的胡塞武裝。美國官員與一名知情的敘利亞軍方官員表示, 相關選項包括提供防禦性援助, 或派遣部隊支援沙烏地支持的葉門部隊進行進攻行動。
油價本周稍早曾因國際能源署(IEA)同意加速釋放石油庫存而承壓。IEA周三表示, 將加快執行3月宣布的庫存釋放計畫, 並優先供應柴油, 以應對燃料價格高漲及戰事造成的供應中斷。不過, 戰略庫存釋放無法完全抵銷中東航運風險與美國原油生產受阻帶來的影響, 市場焦點再度轉向實際供應可能減少的問題。
美國墨西哥灣能源生產則面臨颶風伊賽亞斯帶來的直接衝擊。根據美國海洋礦產管理局周四公布的資料, 墨西哥灣油氣業者已關閉約每日130萬桶原油產能, 相當於當地目前原油產量的62.9%。颶風逼近離岸生產區域, 促使能源公司預防性關閉平台並撤離人員, 以降低風暴造成的安全風險。
殼牌 (SHEL-US)與雪佛龍 (CVX-US)周三表示, 正縮減墨西哥灣離岸作業; 英國石油 (BP-US)則已撤離所有相關人員, 並關閉Na Kika及Thunder Horse兩座平台的生產。多家業者同步停產, 使颶風對供應的影響迅速反映在油價之中。
市場目前同時面對地緣政治與天候兩大供應風險。一方面, 美國與伊朗的談判進展及軍事行動可能性仍牽動市場情緒; 另一方面, 荷姆茲海峽油輪遇襲與墨西哥灣大規模停產, 也增加全球石油運輸和供應的不確定性。即使IEA加快釋放庫存, 若中東衝突持續或美國離岸產能長時間停擺, 國際油價仍可能維持高檔震盪。
paras_en: International oil prices jumped about 4% on Thursday (the 8th), driven by a fresh flare‑up in the Middle East conflict and the threat from Hurricane Isaias in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico. Brent futures closed up $4.08, or 4.1%, at $104.28 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) rose $3.21, or 3.6%, to $91.49 a barrel. At one point during the session both benchmark prices were up more than $5, with Brent hitting its highest level since September 29.

The price gains later narrowed after U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States and Iran were having constructive talks and pledged not to attack Iran before the November 3 midterm elections. The market had been worried about a new U.S. military strike on Iran, and the forecast that the hurricane would make landfall on the Gulf Coast on Friday raised concerns about supply disruptions.

Iran’s Tasnim news agency reported that Foreign Minister Hossein Amir‑Abdollahian said Tehran was reviewing the U.S. proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days and expected to reply in a few days. Nevertheless, the United States announced new sanctions on Thursday targeting individuals, networks and 17 vessels involved in transporting Iranian crude, petroleum and petrochemical products, aiming to increase economic pressure on Tehran.

The deteriorating security situation for shipping in the Middle East keeps the market on guard about supply outlook. The war in Iran entered its eighth month, and the threat to commercial shipping in the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz rose in October. Before the war, about 20% of global oil and fuel moved through the Hormuz Strait; even though Persian Gulf producers increased exports, the number of tanker attacks in the strait last week hit the highest level since the conflict began.

MST Marquee energy head Saul Kavonic said the frequency of Iranian attacks on vessels has risen to the highest level since the war started and could increase further. If shipping risks keep climbing, crude and refined products may still struggle to reach markets even if producers raise exports.

In addition, France and Saudi Arabia are studying various options to use French military assets to protect Saudi’s Yanbu oil export terminal. French Armed Forces chief of staff Fabien Mandon said the two sides are evaluating the options on Thursday. Syria is also weighing whether to provide military assistance to its key ally Saudi Arabia to help counter Iran‑backed Houthi forces in Yemen. U.S. officials and a knowledgeable Syrian military officer said the options include defensive aid or deploying troops to support Saudi‑backed Yemeni forces in offensive operations.

Oil prices earlier this week were under pressure after the International Energy Agency (IEA) agreed to accelerate the release of oil stockpiles. The IEA said on Wednesday it would speed up the March‑announced inventory release plan, prioritising diesel to address rising fuel prices and supply disruptions caused by the war. However, strategic stock releases cannot fully offset the impact of Middle East shipping risks and U.S. production constraints, shifting market focus back to the possibility of reduced actual supply.

U.S. Gulf of Mexico energy production faces a direct hit from Hurricane Isaias. Data released Thursday by the U.S. Bureau of Ocean Energy Management show that Gulf oil and gas operators have shut down about 1.3 million barrels of crude capacity per day, roughly 62.9% of the region’s current output. The approaching storm prompted companies to pre‑emptively shut platforms and evacuate personnel to lower safety risks.

Shell (SHEL‑US) and Chevron (CVX‑US) said on Wednesday they are scaling back offshore operations in the Gulf, while BP (BP‑US) has evacuated all personnel and shut down the Na Kika and Thunder Horse platforms. The simultaneous shutdowns by multiple operators quickly translated the hurricane’s impact into higher oil prices.

The market now faces two major supply risks: geopolitical and weather‑related. On one hand, the progress of U.S.–Iran negotiations and the possibility of military action continue to sway sentiment; on the other, tanker attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and large‑scale shutdowns in the Gulf of Mexico add uncertainty to global oil transport and supply. Even with the IEA speeding up inventory releases, if the Middle East conflict persists or U.S. offshore output stays down for an extended period, international oil prices are likely to remain elevated and volatile.

items.title: 美債跌到能買了？大摩債券高手十年來首度翻多
items.title_en: U.S. Treasuries Drop to Buyable Levels? Morgan Stanley Bond Guru Turns Bullish for First Time in a Decade
paras: 摩根士丹利投資管理旗下績效優異的債券投資人坎杜賈（Vishal Khanduja），十年來首度轉為看好美債，認為處於逾二十年高點的殖利率，正對經濟成長形成制約。
坎杜賈與艾利斯（Brian Ellis）共同管理的伊頓萬斯總報酬債券基金，規模達41億美元，截至6月已將衡量利率風險的存續期間提高至6.07年，高於基準彭博美國綜合債券指數的5.8年。
擔任廣泛市場固定收益團隊主管的坎杜賈表示，這是該基金十多年來首次將存續期間配置提高至基準之上。
他本周接受訪問前，債市才經歷一波重挫。能源價格高漲、經濟韌性強勁及政府大舉舉債，加上企業為支應人工智慧（AI）投資而擴大借款，共同推升殖利率。
美國10年期公債殖利率自6月以來已上升約1個百分點，周三(7日)升至5.36%，再創24年新高。
坎杜賈表示，這波拋售仍可能讓殖利率再「超漲」10至15個基點，但目前的高殖利率已能提供足夠收益，緩衝債券價格進一步下跌的衝擊。
與此同時，借貸成本升高，已開始對全球經濟較脆弱的環節造成壓力，包括低收入消費者、高槓桿企業及負債沉重的政府。
2005年展開華爾街職涯的坎杜賈表示：「我們正控制布局的步調與規模。」他說，團隊正「緩慢但穩定地」利用殖利率超漲的機會，增加投資組合的殖利率曝險。「對未來12個月的展望，我非常、非常有信心。」
坎杜賈管理的基金過去十年年化報酬率達2.9%，超過彭博基準指數的兩倍，並在同期擊敗晨星評比中97%的同類基金。
不過，今年伊朗戰爭引發能源價格飆升，加劇通膨疑慮，該基金也與其他固定收益投資一同受挫。今年以來，基金約下跌2.8%，在同類基金中排名居中，跌幅與基準指數相當。
坎杜賈認為，殖利率升高、金融情勢收緊，加上聯準會立場更趨鷹派，已讓風險報酬條件轉向有利於拉長存續期間。
他的信心部分來自對聯準會的看法。聯準會上月進行三年來首次升息，並暗示接下來還會繼續調升利率。
他形容，聯準會是「強大的債券義警」，其抑制通膨的決心，最終將使經濟成長放緩，限制殖利率的上升空間。他指出，評等較低企業及法國等部分主權借款人的利差擴大，已反映金融情勢收緊。
他看好美債的另一個原因，是債券本身的報酬計算。根據彭博彙整的數據，投資人若以目前水準買進10年期美國公債，未來一年殖利率須升至約6%，債券價格下跌造成的損失才會抵銷利息收益。
「從評價來看，已開始變得極具吸引力。」他說：「我們正仔細尋找能帶動債市反彈、殖利率下滑的催化因素。」
paras_en: Vishal Khanduja, a top-performing bond investor at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, has turned bullish on U.S. Treasuries for the first time in ten years, arguing that yields, which are at a more than twenty‑year high, are now constraining economic growth.

The Eaton Vance Total Return Bond Fund that Khanduja co‑manages with Brian Ellis has $4.1 billion in assets and, as of June, has lengthened its duration measure of interest‑rate risk to 6.07 years, above the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index benchmark of 5.8 years.
Khanduja, who heads the broad‑market fixed‑income team, said this is the first time in more than a decade that the fund has set its duration allocation above the benchmark.

When he was interviewed earlier this week, the bond market had just endured a sharp sell‑off. Rising energy prices, resilient economic activity and massive government borrowing, together with companies increasing debt to fund AI investments, have all pushed yields higher.
The yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury has risen about one percentage point since June, reaching 5.36% on Wednesday the 7th, a fresh 24‑year high.
Khanduja said the sell‑off could still push yields another 10‑15 basis points higher, but the current high yields already provide enough income to cushion the impact of further bond‑price declines.

At the same time, higher borrowing costs are beginning to strain the more vulnerable parts of the global economy, including low‑income consumers, highly leveraged firms and heavily indebted governments.

Starting his Wall Street career in 2005, Khanduja said, “We are controlling the pace and scale of our positioning.” He added the team is “slowly but steadily” using the over‑shoot in yields to increase the portfolio’s yield exposure. “For the outlook over the next 12 months, I am very, very confident.”

Funds managed by Khanduja have delivered a 2.9% annualised return over the past ten years, more than twice the Bloomberg benchmark and beating 97% of peer funds in Morningstar’s rating during the same period.

However, this year’s surge in energy prices sparked by the Iran conflict has heightened inflation concerns, and the fund, like other fixed‑income investments, has suffered. Since the start of the year it is down about 2.8%, roughly in line with its benchmark and placing it in the middle of its peer group.
Khanduja believes that higher yields, tighter financial conditions and an increasingly hawkish Fed stance have shifted risk‑return dynamics in favour of extending duration.
Part of his confidence stems from his view of the Fed. The central bank raised rates last month – its first hike in three years – and signalled further increases are likely.

He described the Fed as a “powerful bond police,” saying its determination to curb inflation will ultimately slow growth and limit how far yields can climb. He noted that widening spreads for lower‑rated corporates and some sovereign borrowers such as France already reflect tighter financial conditions.

Another reason he likes U.S. Treasuries is the math of the bond’s return. Bloomberg data show that an investor buying a 10‑year Treasury at today’s level would need yields to rise to about 6% over the next year for the price loss to offset the interest earned.
“From a valuation perspective, they are becoming extremely attractive,” he said. “We are carefully looking for catalysts that could spark a bond‑market rally and push yields lower.”

items.title: 荷蘭飲料製造商Refresco擬上市 美歐成潛在掛牌地點 KKR持股企業估值看逾100億美元
items.title_en: Dutch Beverage Manufacturer Refresco Plans IPO, US and Europe as Potential Listing Locations, KKR-Owned Firm Valued at Over $10 Billion
paras: 荷蘭飲料製造商 Refresco 傳出正評估首次公開募股(IPO)計畫，目標估值可能超過100億美元。知情人士透露，Refresco 與其所有者私募股權投資公司 KKR (KKR-US) 近期已聽取多家投資銀行的提案，評估銀行在潛在上市案中擔任承銷等相關角色的可能性，上市地點則考慮美國或歐洲。
知情人士表示，若上市計畫順利推進，Refresco 的市場估值可能超過100億美元。不過，目前相關規劃仍處於初步階段，後續可能調整。Refresco 與 KKR 均拒絕對此置評。
KKR 於2022年透過旗下全球基礎建設投資策略，以約80億美元收購 Refresco。這項投資策略主要布局關鍵基礎設施資產，其他投資領域包括公用事業、能源及通訊服務。若 Refresco 最終以逾100億美元估值上市，將高於 KKR 當年的收購價格，但實際估值仍須視市場環境、投資人需求及上市條件而定。
Refresco 成立於1999年，總部位於荷蘭鹿特丹，自稱是全球最大的獨立飲料製造商。公司主要為零售商及品牌飲料企業提供飲料生產、裝瓶、倉儲、物流與配送服務，業務涵蓋北美、歐洲及澳洲，目前在全球擁有85座生產設施。
在零售通路方面，Refresco 與沃爾瑪 (WMT-US) 及 Aldi 等零售商合作，生產自有品牌飲料；在品牌飲料業務方面，合作對象則包括可口可樂 (KO-US)、百事公司 (PEP-US) 及魔爪飲料 (MNST-US) 等企業。這種同時服務零售商自有品牌與大型飲料品牌的商業模式，使 Refresco 在飲料供應鏈中扮演製造及生產服務商的角色。
根據 Refresco 年報，公司2025年營收接近70億美元，調整後息稅折舊攤銷前獲利(EBITDA)約9.3億美元。這些財務數據將是投資人評估潛在上市估值的重要依據。
市場可比較的企業之一，是總部位於美國北卡羅來納州的 Coca-Cola Consolidated (COKE-US)。該公司主要從事可口可樂產品相關業務，與 Refresco 的營運模式並不完全相同，但知情人士認為，仍可作為評估 Refresco 估值的參考對象。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)的數據，Coca-Cola Consolidated 市值約125億美元，企業估值相當於接近12倍 EBITDA。投資人可藉此衡量飲料製造與供應鏈服務企業的市場估值，但不同公司的品牌組合、客戶結構及獲利模式仍可能造成估值差異。
Refresco 考慮上市之際，美國 IPO 市場今年初表現強勁。Dealogic 數據顯示，截至10月8日，2026年美國傳統 IPO 籌資金額已接近1,400億美元，市場原本預期全年有機會接近2021年的歷史高峰。
然而，近期市場波動加劇、債券殖利率走高、升息疑慮升溫，以及投資人對人工智慧支出與相關企業估值的質疑，都可能打亂原先預期熱絡的秋季 IPO 市場。對 Refresco 而言，即使企業營運規模與獲利能力具備一定基礎，最終能否以超過100億美元的估值上市，仍將受到資本市場環境及投資人對估值的接受程度影響。
paras_en: Dutch beverage manufacturer Refresco is reportedly evaluating an initial public offering (IPO) plan, with a target valuation that could exceed $10 billion. Sources say Refresco and its private‑equity owner KKR have recently heard proposals from several investment banks and are assessing the banks' potential underwriting roles, while considering the United States or Europe as possible listing venues.

Sources indicate that if the listing proceeds smoothly, Refresco’s market valuation could surpass $10 billion. However, the planning is still in an early stage and may be adjusted later. Both Refresco and KKR declined to comment on the matter.

KKR acquired Refresco in 2022 through its global infrastructure investment strategy for roughly $8 billion. The strategy focuses on key infrastructure assets, with other investments in utilities, energy and communications services. If Refresco eventually lists at a valuation above $10 billion, it would be higher than KKR’s purchase price, though the actual valuation will depend on market conditions, investor demand and listing terms.

Refresco was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. It describes itself as the world’s largest independent beverage manufacturer. The company primarily provides production, bottling, warehousing, logistics and distribution services to retailers and branded‑beverage companies, operating across North America, Europe and Australia with 85 production facilities worldwide.

In the retail channel, Refresco partners with retailers such as Walmart and Aldi to produce private‑label drinks; on the branded side, it works with companies including Coca‑Cola, PepsiCo and Monster Beverage. This dual model of serving both retailer own‑brands and major beverage brands positions Refresco as a manufacturing and production service provider within the beverage supply chain.

According to Refresco’s annual report, the company’s 2025 revenue is projected to be close to $7 billion, with adjusted EBITDA of about $930 million. These financial figures will be key inputs for investors assessing a potential listing valuation.

One comparable public company is Coca‑Cola Consolidated, based in North Carolina, USA. While its business model differs from Refresco’s, insiders say it can still serve as a reference point for valuing Refresco.

LSEG data shows Coca‑Cola Consolidated has a market capitalization of roughly $12.5 billion, implying an enterprise value of about 12 times EBITDA. Investors can use this multiple to gauge valuations for beverage manufacturing and supply‑chain service firms, though differences in brand portfolios, customer bases and profit models can lead to valuation gaps.

Refresco’s listing considerations come as the U.S. IPO market has been strong early this year. Dealogic data indicates that as of October 8, 2026, U.S. traditional IPO proceeds have approached $140 billion, with expectations that the full‑year total could near the historic peak of 2021.

Nevertheless, heightened market volatility, rising bond yields, mounting rate‑hike concerns, and investor scepticism about AI‑related spending and valuations could disrupt the anticipated lively autumn IPO season. For Refresco, even with solid operational scale and profitability, achieving a valuation above $10 billion will ultimately depend on capital‑market conditions and investor appetite for the price.

items.title: OpenAI營收消息震撼AI產業  較先前報導低200億美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Revenue News Shocks AI Industry, $20 Billion Lower Than Earlier Reports
paras: 《金融時報》(Financial Times) 週四 (8日) 率先引述與投資人分享的財務文件披露，截至 9 月，OpenAI 年化營收約為 500 億美元，低於先前部分媒體報導的約 700 億美元。截稿前，OpenAI 拒絕置評。
知情人士指出，先前較高的數字，源於投資人試圖直接比較 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的營收規模。Anthropic 將透過亞馬遜 AWS、Google Cloud 等雲端合作夥伴產生的銷售收入計入營收，OpenAI 則未採用相同方式。
投資人先前調整 OpenAI 的營收計算，估算其 8 月年化營收達到 400 億美元，之後再結合公司向投資人披露的營收成長超過 70% 資訊，推算出約 700 億美元的規模。
年化營收規模有時是容易造成誤解的銷售指標，通常以單月營收乘以 12 計算，並非實際全年營收。不過，這仍已成為矽谷快速成長新創公司普遍採用的熱門指標。
由於OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兩家公司計算方式不同，相關數字也不能直接視為相同基準下的比較。
依報導列出的數字，OpenAI 年化營收接近 500 億美元，低於 Anthropic 約 650 億美元的規模。
兩家公司正積極爭取企業客戶，推出程式設計及通用型 AI 代理產品。OpenAI 上週舉行年度開發者大會，發布面向企業工作者的 Dots AI 代理，以及最新模型 GPT-6.1 Sol。
市場也持續關注兩家公司的上市計畫。OpenAI 預期可能於 2027 年初啟動首次公開發行 (IPO)，Anthropic 則傳出可能在今年感恩節前上市，公開版 S-1 招股文件有望近期公布，惟相關時程仍未正式確認。
paras_en: Financial Times reported on Thursday (the 8th) that, citing financial documents shared with investors, OpenAI’s annualized revenue as of September was about $50 billion, lower than the roughly $70 billion reported by some media earlier. OpenAI declined to comment before the deadline.

Sources said the higher earlier figure stemmed from investors trying to compare OpenAI directly with Anthropic’s revenue. Anthropic counts sales revenue generated through cloud partners such as Amazon AWS and Google Cloud, whereas OpenAI does not use the same method.

Investors had previously adjusted OpenAI’s revenue calculation, estimating its August annualized revenue at $40 billion, and then combined that with the company’s disclosed revenue growth of over 70% to extrapolate a size of about $70 billion.

Annualized revenue can be a misleading sales metric, usually calculated by multiplying a single month’s revenue by 12 rather than reflecting actual full‑year revenue. Nonetheless, it has become a popular metric among fast‑growing Silicon Valley startups.
Because OpenAI and Anthropic use different calculation methods, the figures cannot be directly compared on the same basis.
Based on the numbers reported, OpenAI’s annualized revenue is close to $50 billion, lower than Anthropic’s roughly $65 billion scale.

Both companies are actively courting enterprise customers, launching programming and general‑purpose AI agent products. OpenAI held its annual developer conference last week, unveiling the Dots AI agent for business users and the latest model GPT‑6.1 Sol.

The market continues to watch the two firms’ IPO plans. OpenAI may launch its IPO in early 2027, while Anthropic is rumored to go public before this year’s Thanksgiving, with a public S‑1 expected soon, though timelines are not officially confirmed.

items.title: AI液冷組件需求訂單激增 榮惠9月、Q3營收雙創新高本季展望樂觀
items.title_en: AI Liquid‑Cooling Component Demand Surges, Rong Hui September and Q3 Revenue Reach New Highs, Outlook Optimistic
paras: AI液冷及PCB供應商榮惠-KY(6924-TW)今(8)日公布最新營收資訊，2026年9月營收2.92億元，月增20.45%、年增141倍，主要受惠AI液冷業務進入放量期，CDU（冷卻分配單元）出貨量暢旺，激勵單月、第三季營收7.2億元，創歷史新高，月增39.9%，年增高達80.32%。展望後市，客戶需求強勁，第四季營運樂觀。
榮惠-KY在2026年前9月營收17.07億元，已超越去年全年的16.93億元，年成長34.76%。榮惠-KY2026年前9月的AI伺服器產品營收占比更是加速攀升至11.4%。
榮惠-KY董事長劉世璘表示，客戶追加水冷模組與水冷快速接頭（QD）、感應器、PCBA、板金機殼等相關零組件，加上新開發美系客戶出貨量擴大，站穩伺服器產業擴張浪潮。以地區別來看，日本市場受惠記憶體漲價及需求大增營收翻倍，泰國市場車用基板需求強勁，帶動整體營運走強。
劉世璘表示，公司以AI伺服器液冷供應服務商為核心定位，提供客戶FPC、Rigid-flex、Metal及HDI等多種類基板一站式服務的策略。上半年AI伺服器產品營收占比僅8.2％，3Q 占比逐步攀升，累計前９月提升至11.4％。
展望後市，客戶對水冷模組與零組件加單效應，可望繼續延續，因此本季展望樂觀。此外，鑒於上游玻纖布、樹酯、銅箔基板、記憶體、被動元件等基板原材料成本不斷攀升，將持續對客戶反映轉嫁，迄今已有近九成客戶達到100%轉嫁漲價，有助產業健康發展。
液冷之外，IPC及PCB受惠日本、泰國市場車用基板需求強勁，同步挹注營運成長榮惠第二季毛利率成長至23.2，法人認為，隨著第三季營運規模擴大，毛利率等獲利指標值得期待。
榮惠-KY2026年第二季營收5.15億元，毛利率23.2%，季減3.27個百分點，年增1.42個百分點，稅後純益4234萬元，季減9.2%，年增4.09倍，單季每股純益2.05元。榮惠 – KY在2026年上半年營收9.87億元，毛利率24.77%，年增4.11個百分點，稅後純益8896萬元，年增1.49倍，每股純益4.31元。
paras_en: AI liquid‑cooling and PCB supplier Rong Hui‑KY (6924‑TW) announced on the 8th that its September 2026 revenue was NT$292 million, up 20.45% month‑over‑month and 141‑fold year‑over‑year, driven by AI liquid‑cooling business entering a volume phase and strong shipments of cooling distribution units (CDU). This boosted single‑month and third‑quarter revenue to NT$720 million, a historic high, up 39.9% month‑over‑month and 80.32% year‑over‑year. The company is optimistic for Q4 as customer demand remains strong.

Rong Hui‑KY’s revenue for the first nine months of 2026 totaled NT$1.707 billion, surpassing the full‑year 2025 figure of NT$1.693 billion and representing a 34.76% year‑over‑year increase. The share of AI server product revenue accelerated to 11.4% of total sales for the period.

Chairman Liu Shilin said customers have added water‑cool modules, quick‑disconnect (QD) fittings, sensors, PCBA and metal housings, and shipments to newly developed U.S. customers have expanded, cementing the company’s position in the server industry expansion wave. Regionally, the Japanese market benefited from memory price hikes and a surge in demand, doubling revenue, while strong automotive substrate demand in Thailand also bolstered overall performance.

Liu explained that the company positions itself as a core AI‑server liquid‑cooling supplier, offering a one‑stop service for various substrates such as FPC, rigid‑flex, metal and HDI. AI‑server product revenue accounted for only 8.2% in the first half of the year, rising gradually in Q3 and reaching 11.4% for the first nine months.

Looking ahead, the incremental orders for water‑cool modules and components are expected to continue, making the current‑quarter outlook optimistic. Moreover, rising costs of upstream materials—including glass‑fiber cloth, resin, copper‑foil substrates, memory and passive components—are being passed on to customers; to date nearly 90% of customers have achieved a 100% price pass‑through, supporting healthy industry development.

Beyond liquid cooling, IPC and PCB businesses benefit from strong automotive substrate demand in Japan and Thailand, further fueling operating growth. Rong Hui’s Q2 gross margin rose to 23.2%, and analysts believe that with the expanded scale in Q3, profitability metrics such as margin are worth期待 (expected to improve).

Rong Hui‑KY’s Q2 2026 revenue was NT$515 million with a gross margin of 23.2%, down 3.27 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but up 1.42 points year‑over‑year. After‑tax profit was NT$42.34 million, down 9.2% quarter‑over‑quarter but up 4.09‑fold year‑over‑year, yielding an EPS of NT$2.05. For the first half of 2026, revenue reached NT$987 million, gross margin 24.77% (up 4.11 points YoY), after‑tax profit NT$88.96 million (up 1.49‑fold YoY) and EPS NT$4.31.

items.title: LEO概念股昇達科前9月營收大增71% 重點客戶新一代產品獲順利認證
items.title_en: LEO Concept Stock Shengda Technology Posts 71% Revenue Surge in First Nine Months; Key Customer's Next-Gen Product Gains Smooth Certification
paras: 深耕低軌衛星與毫米波通訊元件的昇達科技(3491-TW)今(8)日公布9月營收，受惠全球低軌衛星(LEO)建置需求持續升溫，公司營運延續強勁成長態勢，單月營收2.92億元，月減9.22%，年增52.49%，值得注意的是，昇達科已連續六個月單月營收年增率超過50%，昇達科今年前三季累計營收27.65億元，年增70.93%，顯示低軌衛星相關產品需求並非單月拉貨效應，而是逐步形成具有延續性的成長趨勢。
從營運基本面來看，低軌衛星仍是推升昇達科成長的主要引擎。隨著既有客戶衛星部署規模持續擴大，公司相關毫米波通訊產品出貨同步成長；另一方面，重點客戶新一代產品認證進展順利，意味昇達科不僅受惠既有世代產品放量，也持續跟進客戶下一世代衛星架構與產品升級，有利於延續後續產品生命周期及訂單能見度。
近期全球LEO產業發展亦持續釋出正向訊號。根據CelesTrak 在10月7日的衛星目錄顯示，全球目前約有1.7萬顆可追蹤的在軌運作衛星（active satellites）；依各業者既有規劃，未來幾年規模可能接近5萬1700顆，接近目前的三倍，而此數據主要反映既有低軌衛星星系的擴張，尚未充分納入近年逐步浮現的太空運算、軌道資料中心等新興應用。
隨著衛星應用由通訊進一步朝資料處理與運算延伸，未來對高頻寬、低延遲及毫米波通訊元件的需求，仍具進一步擴大的可能性。由此顯示全球低軌衛星基礎建設仍處於快速擴張階段。

值得注意的是，LEO產業正由過去以「新星系建置」為主，逐步進入新建、擴充與既有星系汰換並行的新階段。歐洲Eutelsat今年9月再追加229顆OneWeb衛星，使其已向Airbus規劃採購的新一代OneWeb衛星總數達669顆；10月初首批32顆新衛星已完成生產並準備進入發射程序，未來將逐步汰換屆齡衛星並提升星系容量與性能。對供應鏈而言，這意味LEO需求來源正從一次性的星系建置，進一步延伸至持續性的補充、汰換與規格升級。

此外，全球低軌衛星產業近期發展持續釋出正向訊號，除了既有商業衛星星系加速部署及汰換外，人工智慧運算、國防安全與通訊韌性等新興應用，正為產業開啟新一波成長契機。在AI應用方面，Google於10月初成功發射搭載AI運算晶片的實驗衛星，正式展開太空運算技術的在軌驗證，顯示衛星應用正由傳統通訊與資料傳輸，逐步延伸至在軌資料處理及人工智慧運算。另一方面，國防與通訊韌性需求亦持續升溫，Nokia與ICEYE近期宣布合作開發政府及國防專用低軌衛星通訊系統；歐盟IRIS安全衛星通訊計畫亦已啟動首階段衛星開發，美國則持續推進分散式軍事低軌衛星網路，反映各國正加速將衛星通訊納入國家安全與關鍵基礎設施布局。由此顯示低軌衛星的戰略價值也持續提高。
法人分析，全球低軌衛星產業的成長動能，正由既有商業星系擴張，進一步延伸至衛星汰換、國防韌性及AI等多元應用，帶動衛星通訊市場朝更大規模、更高效能及更高可靠度方向發展。

在此一趨勢下，具備毫米波通訊技術、高頻精密製造與穩定量產能力的供應商，將更有機會承接產業擴張所帶來的需求。昇達科長期深耕毫米波通訊技術，並已切入國際衛星供應鏈，隨著重點客戶新一代產品認證進展順利，加上低軌衛星應用日益多元，吸引更多國際業者投入衛星系統建置與新興應用開發，帶動整體市場需求持續擴大，昇達科可望憑藉既有技術與量產優勢，持續掌握衛星通訊規格升級、既有客戶需求成長及新客戶開發所帶來的多重商機。
對昇達科而言，2026年來已連續6個月營收年增逾50%、前三季營收年增71%，以及重點客戶新一代產品認證順利，三項指標分別反映「當期出貨」、「累計成長」與「下一階段產品布局」，使公司成長動能更具延續性。
法人認為，昇達科長期深耕毫米波通訊技術，並已切入國際衛星供應鏈，在全球LEO市場由規模部署進一步走向汰換與技術升級之際，屬於最能直接承接需求放大的台灣關鍵供應商之一，後續接單、出貨及新一代產品放量進度值得持續關注。
paras_en: Shengda Technology (3491-TW), which focuses on low‑orbit satellite and millimeter‑wave communication components, announced its September revenue today (the 8th). Benefiting from sustained global demand for low‑orbit satellite (LEO) deployments, the company continued its strong growth trajectory with monthly revenue of NT$292 million, down 9.22% month‑over‑month but up 52.49% year‑over‑year. Notably, Shengda has posted a year‑over‑year monthly revenue growth exceeding 50% for six consecutive months, and its cumulative revenue for the first three quarters this year reached NT$2.765 billion, up 70.93% year‑over‑year, indicating that demand for LEO‑related products is not a one‑off shipping surge but a steadily developing growth trend.

From an operational standpoint, low‑orbit satellites remain the primary engine driving Shengda's growth. As existing customers expand their satellite deployment scales, shipments of the company's millimeter‑wave communication products have risen in tandem; meanwhile, progress on certification of a key customer's next‑generation product is proceeding smoothly, meaning Shengda benefits not only from volume increases of current‑generation products but also from following the customer's next‑generation satellite architectures and product upgrades, which supports continued product lifecycle and order visibility.

Recent global LEO industry developments continue to send positive signals. According to CelesTrak’s satellite catalog on October 7, there are currently about 17,000 trackable active satellites in orbit worldwide; based on existing plans from various operators, the total could approach 51,700 satellites in the coming years—nearly three times the current figure. This estimate reflects the expansion of existing low‑orbit satellite constellations and does not yet fully account for emerging applications such as space computing and orbital data centers that have been surfacing in recent years.

As satellite applications move beyond communications toward data processing and computing, future demand for high‑bandwidth, low‑latency millimeter‑wave components is likely to expand further, underscoring that global low‑orbit satellite infrastructure remains in a rapid expansion phase.

It is noteworthy that the LEO industry is shifting from a focus on "new constellation builds" to a new stage where new builds, expansions, and the replacement of existing constellations occur in parallel. In September, Europe’s Eutelsat added another 229 OneWeb satellites, bringing the total number of next‑generation OneWeb satellites it plans to procure from Airbus to 669. In early October, the first batch of 32 new satellites completed production and prepared for launch, which will gradually replace aging satellites and boost constellation capacity and performance. For the supply chain, this means LEO demand is moving from one‑off constellation builds to ongoing replenishment, replacement, and specification upgrades.

Moreover, recent global low‑orbit satellite industry developments continue to emit positive signals. In addition to accelerated deployment and replacement of existing commercial constellations, emerging applications such as AI computing, defense security, and communications resilience are opening a new wave of growth opportunities. In AI, Google successfully launched an experimental satellite equipped with an AI‑processing chip in early October, formally beginning on‑orbit validation of space‑computing technology and showing that satellite use is extending from traditional communications and data transmission to on‑orbit data processing and AI computing. Meanwhile, defense and communications‑resilience needs are also heating up, with Nokia and ICEYE recently announcing a joint development of low‑orbit satellite communications systems for government and defense use; the EU’s IRIS secure satellite communications program has launched its first‑phase satellite development; and the United States continues to advance a distributed military low‑orbit satellite network, reflecting nations’ accelerating integration of satellite communications into national security and critical infrastructure strategies, thereby raising the strategic value of low‑orbit satellites.

Analysts note that the growth momentum of the global low‑orbit satellite industry is evolving from the expansion of existing commercial constellations to further satellite replacement, defense resilience, and AI‑driven applications, driving the satellite communications market toward larger scale, higher performance, and greater reliability.

In this trend, suppliers possessing millimeter‑wave communication technology, high‑frequency precision manufacturing, and stable mass‑production capabilities are poised to capture the demand generated by industry expansion. Shengda has long cultivated millimeter‑wave communication expertise and has entered the international satellite supply chain. With smooth progress on a key customer’s next‑generation product certification and the increasingly diverse applications of low‑orbit satellites attracting more international players to satellite system construction and emerging‑application development, overall market demand is set to keep expanding. Leveraging its existing technology and mass‑production advantages, Shengda can continue to seize multiple business opportunities arising from satellite communication specification upgrades, growing existing‑customer needs, and new‑customer development.

For Shengda, having posted year‑over‑year revenue growth exceeding 50% for six consecutive months in 2026, a 71% year‑over‑year increase for the first three quarters, and smooth certification of a key customer’s next‑generation product, these three indicators respectively reflect "current shipments," "cumulative growth," and "next‑stage product positioning," making the company’s growth momentum more sustainable.

Analysts believe that Shengda’s long‑term focus on millimeter‑wave communication technology and its integration into the international satellite supply chain position it as one of Taiwan’s key suppliers best able to directly capture the expanding demand as the global LEO market moves from scale deployment to replacement and technology upgrades. Ongoing order intake, shipments, and the rollout of next‑generation products merit close monitoring.

items.title: 「商總台商騰飛計畫」啟動 許舒博：鏈結資金及資源助台商布局全球
items.title_en: ‘Business Association Taiwan Entrepreneurs Takeoff Plan’ Launched; Xu Shubo: Linking Capital and Resources to Help Taiwanese Businesses Expand Globally
paras: 商業總會為建構全球台商串聯平台，於今(8)日舉辦首屆「商總國際台商騰飛計畫」。理事長許舒博表示，該計畫旨在串聯全球散布各地的僑台商與國內產業鏈，不僅要為海外台商打造強而有力的合作與資金挹注，也期盼能結合日本三井等海外大企業，在海外推「Taiwan Town(台灣城)」的概念，協助大舉外移的高科技人才及連鎖餐飲業開闢出全新的國際據點。
許舒博表示，隨著全球供應鏈加速重組，AI、綠能、智慧製造等新興產業快速發展，海外台商對台灣優勢產業、技術、人才及服務資源的需求也日益增加，商總推出國際台商騰飛計畫(Global Business Turn Up Program)，以「Turn Up」英文的核心理念，協助國內企業與海外台商在國際提升能量、拓展商機，企業發展與人才培育，並將服務範圍從傳統商務交流延伸至產業合作與資源整合。
商總指出，該平台將以台商的實際需求作為策略規劃的出發點，以「平臺、串連、整合」為推動架構，透過「創新、創造、創意」的行動思維，結合商總既有的專業、產業與國際資源，推海外商會交流、商務合作、諮詢輔導、雙向貿易、培訓課程及資源共享等服務。
許舒博強調，讓台商需求與台灣產業優勢能夠有效對接，每年招募50家以上海外台商，與商總國內產業160餘公會從「認識」走向「合作」，從「交流」創造實質商機，計畫將導入「諮詢輔導、資源鏈結、資金導入」等三大核心服務。
經濟部投資促進司長陳愛蘭表示，政府透過「投資台灣三大方案2.0」擴大投資支持，鼓勵全球台商及外商投資，並協助企業推動AI與節能轉型。此次商總提供一條龍整合服務，協助企業加速投資落地，希望深化國際商貿交流與產業合作，開創更多投資與合作商機。
資金支援方面，海外信保基金董事長侯立洋也說明，海外信保長期扮演台商與僑胞最佳後盾，每位僑台商可透過國內外銀行向該基金申請最高銀行授信金額200萬美元的海外信保保證，保證成數將依送保機構及個案風險核定5成-8成，藉由有效分擔銀行的授信風險，大幅提升金融機構的放款意願，希望挹注台商順利取得事業發展資金。
騰飛計畫總召集人陳榮進則表示，海外台商深耕全球，累積豐富的在地市場、人脈與通路資源，台灣擁完整產業鏈、技術、人才與品牌優勢，該計畫未來將透過三資服務，串聯台商力量，從聯誼走向合作、從交流走向商機，讓全球台灣人幫助世界台灣人。
許舒博強調，「商總國際台商騰飛計畫」不僅是台商服務計畫，更是連結台灣與台商的重要橋梁，未來將持續串聯政府、產業、公協會及民間各界力量，透過串聯、資源整合與專業服務，協助臺商掌握全球市場脈動、鏈結臺灣產業優勢，轉化為具體合作與商業成果。
為讓全球台商在國際市場持續「Turn Up」，串起台灣與全球的產業網絡，許舒博也透漏，商總將於今(2026）年底12月17日，在南港展覽館舉辦「2026台灣服務業國際博覽會、世界台商聯合交流合作平台暨商總80周年慶」活動，希望讓台灣中小型企業走向全世界。
paras_en: The Business Association held the inaugural “International Taiwanese Entrepreneurs Takeoff Plan” today (the 8th) to build a global platform linking Taiwanese businesses abroad. Chairman Xu Shubo said the plan aims to connect overseas Taiwanese entrepreneurs with domestic supply chains, providing strong cooperation and capital infusion, and hopes to partner with major overseas firms such as Japan’s Mitsui to promote the concept of “Taiwan Town” abroad, helping high‑tech talent and chain‑restaurant operators relocating overseas establish new international footholds.

Xu explained that as global supply chains are rapidly reshaping and emerging sectors such as AI, green energy, and smart manufacturing expand, overseas Taiwanese entrepreneurs are increasingly seeking Taiwan’s advantages in industry, technology, talent, and services. The Business Association therefore launched the Global Business Turn Up Program, using the core idea of “Turn Up” to help domestic firms and overseas Taiwanese businesses boost capabilities, explore opportunities, develop enterprises and cultivate talent, extending services beyond traditional business exchanges to industrial cooperation and resource integration.

The Association noted that the platform will start from the concrete needs of Taiwanese entrepreneurs, using a “platform‑connect‑integrate” framework. Guided by the action mindset of “innovation, creation, creativity,” it will combine the Association’s existing expertise, industry links, and international resources to offer services such as overseas chamber exchanges, business cooperation, consulting, bilateral trade, training courses, and resource sharing.

Xu emphasized that aligning Taiwanese entrepreneurs’ needs with Taiwan’s industrial strengths is key. The program will recruit more than 50 overseas Taiwanese firms each year and link them with over 160 domestic industry associations, moving from “awareness” to “cooperation” and from “exchange” to tangible business opportunities. It will deliver three core services: consulting, resource linking, and capital introduction.

Minister of the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Investment Promotion Division, Chen Ailan, said the government is expanding investment support through the “Invest Taiwan Three‑Major‑Plans 2.0,” encouraging global Taiwanese and foreign investors and assisting companies in AI and energy‑saving transformations. The Business Association’s one‑stop integrated service will help firms accelerate investment implementation, deepen international trade exchanges and industrial cooperation, and create more investment and partnership opportunities.

Regarding financing, Overseas Credit Insurance Fund Chairman Hou Liyang explained that the fund has long served as a reliable backstop for Taiwanese entrepreneurs and overseas compatriots. Each overseas Taiwanese entrepreneur can apply through domestic or foreign banks for a maximum overseas credit guarantee of US$2 million, with guarantee ratios ranging from 50% to 80% depending on the issuing institution and case risk. By sharing bank credit risk, the fund significantly boosts lenders’ willingness to extend loans, helping entrepreneurs secure development capital.

Program convener Chen Rongjin said overseas Taiwanese entrepreneurs have deep roots worldwide, accumulating rich local market knowledge, networks, and channel resources. Taiwan possesses a complete industrial chain, technology, talent, and brand advantages. The plan will, through three‑service resource integration, link Taiwanese entrepreneurial strength, moving from networking to cooperation and from exchange to business opportunities, enabling Taiwanese people around the globe to help each other.

Xu stressed that the “International Taiwanese Entrepreneurs Takeoff Plan” is not only a service program for Taiwanese businesses but also a vital bridge linking Taiwan with its overseas entrepreneurs. Going forward, the Association will continuously connect government, industry, public‑private associations, and civil society, leveraging networking, resource integration, and professional services to help Taiwanese entrepreneurs grasp global market trends, link Taiwan’s industrial strengths, and translate them into concrete collaborations and commercial results.

To keep global Taiwanese entrepreneurs continuously “Turning Up” in international markets and to weave Taiwan’s industrial network with the world’s, Xu revealed that the Association will hold the “2026 Taiwan Service Industry International Expo, World Taiwanese Entrepreneurs Joint Exchange and Cooperation Platform, and Business Association 80th Anniversary Celebration” on December 17, 2026, at the Nangang Exhibition Hall, aiming to propel Taiwan’s small and medium‑sized enterprises onto the global stage.

items.title: 飛捷9月、Q3營收創同期高 前三季營收超越去年全年
items.title_en: Feijie September, Q3 Revenue Hits Same-Period High, First Three Quarters Revenue Surpasses Last Year Full Year
paras: 工業電腦廠飛捷(6206-TW)今(8)日公告9月營收5.92億元，年增30%，單月營收連續8個月逾5億元第三季營收17.44億元，年增42%，創歷史同期新高；累計前三季營收51.36億元，年增30%，並已超過去年全年的50.33億元。
飛捷說明，前三季區域市場來看，美洲營收年增逾三成，為集團營收成長的主力，其中自今年初於美國NRF展正式推廣的Payment POS支付整合解決方案，單一客戶前三季累計貢獻已突破5億元，成為美洲成長的重要來源。
歐洲市場方面，子公司BOXTEC以英國零售市場為主要動能，今年拓展體育用品及連鎖超市等新客戶；在當地人力短缺的背景下，自助結帳機（Self-checkout）加速導入門市，同時門市數位設備的算力需求提升，帶動Box PC出貨同步增加。
展望後市，飛捷將持續深耕國際大型連鎖餐飲與零售通路，憑藉多樣態端點的設計與製造實力，推動既有客戶升級導入Payment POS等整合機種，加速產品線在客戶門店中的橫向擴張；同時以共用組件設計提升規模效益。新產品除挹注營收外，也成為切入新客戶的契機，同步推動產品組合與客戶組合的優化。
paras_en: Industrial computer maker Feijie (6206-TW) announced today (8th) that September revenue was NT$5.92 billion, up 30% year‑over‑year, marking the eighth consecutive month with revenue exceeding NT$5 billion. Q3 revenue was NT$17.44 billion, up 42% year‑over‑year, a historic same‑period high; cumulative revenue for the first three quarters reached NT$51.36 billion, up 30% year‑over‑year, already exceeding last year’s full‑year total of NT$50.33 billion.

Feijie explained that, by region, revenue in the Americas grew more than 30% year‑over‑year, driving the group’s overall growth. The Payment POS integrated solution, officially launched at the NRF show in the United States earlier this year, has contributed over NT$5 billion from a single customer in the first three quarters, becoming a key source of growth in the Americas.

In Europe, subsidiary BOXTEC is focusing on the UK retail market as its main engine, expanding into new customers such as sporting‑goods retailers and chain supermarkets this year. Amid local labor shortages, self‑checkout machines are being rolled out faster in stores, and the demand for computing power of in‑store digital equipment is rising, boosting shipments of Box PCs.

Looking ahead, Feijie will continue to deepen its presence in large international restaurant and retail chains. Leveraging its versatile endpoint design and manufacturing capabilities, it will encourage existing customers to upgrade to integrated models such as Payment POS, accelerating horizontal expansion of product lines across client stores. At the same time, it will improve scale economies through shared‑component design. New products not only add revenue but also serve as entry points for new customers, driving simultaneous optimization of the product and customer portfolios.

items.title: 利息+手收挹注！彰銀前9月稅後賺173.7億元 EPS達1.44元
items.title_en: Interest and Fees Boost! Chang Hwa Bank Posts NT$17.37 Billion After‑Tax Profit for Jan‑Sep, EPS Reaches NT$1.44
paras: 彰銀今(8)日公布115年9月自結稅後純益18.03億元，年增18.91%，累計前9月累計合併稅後純益173.7億元，年增22.75%，每股稅後純益(EPS)為1.44元，主要受惠於核心業務利息及手續費淨收益表現良好，展現穩定獲利動能。
彰銀持續以「SMART」營運策略推動各項業務發展，以客戶需求為核心，深化數位轉型、財富管理、永續及普惠金融，以科技創新提升客戶服務體驗，並透過綠色存款及綠色授信引導資金投入永續領域。今年於「2026年第23屆國家品牌玉山獎」一舉獲得8項大獎，獲獎領域涵蓋數位金融、智慧支付、普惠金融、綠色金融及高齡金融，展現百年品牌持續創新轉型的成果。
財富管理方面，彰銀持續擴充高資產專家服務團隊，並於今年3月啟動高雄亞灣專區高資產財富管理中心，聚焦槓桿優化、家族傳承及稅務規劃，提供高資產客戶一站式服務；同時深化信託、安養及全齡金融服務，滿足不同生命階段的金融需求。

除營運表現亮眼外，彰銀積極落實公平待客與普惠金融，持續推動「Guardian Star反詐守護星行動計劃」，運用AI及智慧科技強化防詐，並透過失智友善、視障數位服務、偏鄉金融教育及兒少金融教育等措施，擴大金融服務可及性；榮獲金管會公布115 年公平待客原則評核結果前25%銀行業者，已連續2年獲得肯定，同時蟬聯今周刊「最佳公平待客獎」第一名，並獲「最佳普惠金融獎」第三名，另舉辦第四屆公平待客論壇，聚焦AI防詐、風險治理及全齡金融，持續深化公平待客文化。
彰銀表示，未來將持續以客戶需求為核心，深化數位科技與AI應用，拓展財富管理、擴大永續及普惠金融布局，在穩健經營基礎上致力提升獲利動能與品牌價值，提供更智慧、安全、便利且友善的金融服務，朝「亞太優質的國際金融好夥伴，創造智慧金融與永續價值」願景穩健邁進。
paras_en: Chang Hwa Bank announced today (the 8th) that its net profit after tax for September 2023 was NT$1.803 billion, up 18.91% year‑over‑year. For the first nine months, consolidated after‑tax profit totaled NT$17.37 billion, a 22.75% increase, and earnings per share (EPS) were NT$1.44, driven mainly by strong core‑business interest and fee net earnings, reflecting stable profit momentum.

The bank continues to advance its “SMART” operating strategy, putting customer needs at the core while deepening digital transformation, wealth management, sustainability and inclusive finance. Technology innovation is used to enhance customer experience, and green deposits and green loans steer capital toward sustainable projects. This year the bank won eight awards at the 23rd National Brand Yushan Awards 2026, covering digital finance, smart payments, inclusive finance, green finance and senior finance, showcasing the centennial brand’s ongoing innovation and transformation.

In wealth management, Chang Hwa Bank keeps expanding its high‑net‑worth specialist team and launched a high‑net‑worth wealth management center in Kaohsiung’s Asia Bay district in March. The center focuses on leverage optimization, family succession and tax planning, offering one‑stop services for affluent clients. At the same time, the bank deepens trust, senior‑care and all‑age financial services to meet the needs of different life stages.

Beyond strong operating results, the bank actively implements fair‑customer service and inclusive finance. It continues the “Guardian Star Anti‑Fraud Initiative,” using AI and smart technology to strengthen fraud prevention, and expands accessibility through dementia‑friendly, visually‑impaired digital services, rural financial education and youth financial education. The bank ranked in the top 25% of banks in the Financial Supervisory Commission’s 2023 Fair‑Customer Service assessment for the second consecutive year, won first place in the “Best Fair‑Customer Service Award” from This Week Magazine, placed third for the “Best Inclusive Finance Award,” and hosted the 4th Fair‑Customer Forum focusing on AI fraud prevention, risk governance and all‑age finance, further embedding a fair‑customer culture.

Chang Hwa Bank says it will keep customer needs at the core, deepen digital and AI applications, expand wealth management, and broaden its sustainability and inclusive‑finance footprint. Building on a solid operational foundation, it aims to boost profit momentum and brand value, delivering smarter, safer, more convenient and friendly financial services, and steadily moving toward its vision of becoming “a high‑quality international financial partner in Asia‑Pacific, creating smart finance and sustainable value.”

items.title: 工程完工認列挹注大 千附前3季營收38.9億元創歷史高年增近63%
items.title_en: Project completions recognized boost Qianfu Industrial's Q1‑Q3 revenue to NT$3.89 billion, a historic high, with year‑over‑year growth close to 63%
paras: 千附實業(8383-TW)今(8)日公佈9月營收為4.68億元，月減8.42%，年增83.65%，累計2026年1-3季營收達38.9億元，為歷年同期新高。公司表示，受惠全球AI與半導體產業持續擴大資本支出，帶動高階晶圓廠建廠工程、廠務系統及精密零組件需求維持高檔，第三季起廠務工程案件陸續進入完工及營收認列階段，
千附第三季營收14.76億元，年增78.02%。
千附子公司千附精密(6829-TW)第二套「量子電腦超低溫真空腔體設備」也完成出貨並提列挹注，帶動整體營運維持穩健成長。
千附表示，隨著AI、高效能運算（HPC）等應用快速發展，全球半導體大廠持續推進先進製程與先進封裝佈局，相關廠務工程需求亦同步升溫。公司目前廠務工程訂單維持良好能見度，第三季起部分大型專案陸續進入完工認列，預期第四季仍有多項工程案件依進度完成驗收、貢獻營收，持續推升全年營運表現。
另一方面，公司近期更成功取得一家國內大型半導體封裝測試廠之合格供應商資格，預計自今年第四季逐步啟動相關合作，為未來廠務工程業務拓展增添新的成長動能。
千附子公司千附精密持續布局高附加價值市場。除深耕成長中的半導體與光電產業外，在量子電腦領域也穩健推進，8月順利完成第二套設備出貨並認列營收，逐步累積實績。此外，千附精密嘉義馬稠後新廠正按既定進度推進，預計今年底前可取得使用執照。新廠啟用後，將進一步強化半導體精密零組件的製造實力，提前為未來半導體設備及高階製程相關零組件需求做好產能佈局。
展望後市，千附表示，AI浪潮仍持續推升全球半導體產業投資，主要晶圓廠及相關供應鏈資本支出維持擴張趨勢，市場對廠務工程、精密設備及關鍵零組件的需求可望延續，公司除持續掌握既有半導體大廠擴廠商機，亦將透過新客戶供應鏈資格、廠務工程業務拓展及千附精密精密製造能力提升，擴大市場佈局；隨工程案件陸續認列、新廠產能開出，以及航太國防與量子電腦等新興應用持續貢獻，對2027年營運維持穩健成長深具信心。
paras_en: Qianfu Industrial (8383‑TW) announced today (the 8th) that September revenue was NT$468 million, down 8.42% month‑over‑month but up 83.65% year‑over‑year, bringing cumulative revenue for the first three quarters of 2026 to NT$3.89 billion – a record high for the same period in history. The company said that continued expansion of capital expenditures in the global AI and semiconductor sectors has kept demand for high‑end wafer‑fab construction projects, plant‑system installations and precision components at a premium level, and that from the third quarter onward plant‑engineering contracts are progressively being completed and recognized as revenue.
Qianfu's third‑quarter revenue was NT$1.476 billion, up 78.02% year‑over‑year.

Qianfu's subsidiary Qianfu Precision (6829‑TW) completed shipment of its second set of "quantum‑computer ultra‑low‑temperature vacuum‑chamber equipment" and recorded the associated revenue, contributing to the company's steady overall growth.

Qianfu noted that as AI and high‑performance computing (HPC) applications develop rapidly, major global semiconductor manufacturers are continuing to advance advanced process and advanced‑packaging roadmaps, which in turn raises demand for related plant‑engineering services. The company currently enjoys good visibility on plant‑engineering orders, with several large projects entering the completion‑recognition stage from the third quarter onward, and expects many more projects to be accepted and to contribute revenue in the fourth quarter, further lifting full‑year performance.

Separately, the company recently secured qualified‑supplier status for a large domestic semiconductor packaging and testing plant, and plans to gradually launch related cooperation from the fourth quarter of this year, adding a new growth engine to its plant‑engineering business expansion.

Qianfu Precision continues to target high‑value‑added markets. In addition to deepening its presence in the growing semiconductor and optoelectronics sectors, it is making steady progress in the quantum‑computer field, having successfully shipped the second set of equipment in August and recognized the revenue, thereby gradually building a track record. Moreover, Qianfu Precision's new plant in Chiayi’s Machou area is progressing on schedule and is expected to obtain its operating license before the end of the year. Once operational, the plant will further strengthen the company's manufacturing capability for semiconductor precision components and position capacity ahead of future demand for semiconductor equipment and advanced‑process parts.

Looking ahead, Qianfu said the AI wave continues to lift global semiconductor investment, with major wafer fabs and related supply‑chain capital spending remaining on an expansion trajectory. Demand for plant‑engineering services, precision equipment and key components is expected to persist. The company will keep capturing expansion opportunities from existing semiconductor giants while also expanding its market reach through new‑customer supply‑chain qualifications, plant‑engineering business development and enhanced precision‑manufacturing capabilities at Qianfu Precision. With engineering projects being recognized, new‑plant capacity coming online, and emerging applications such as aerospace‑defense and quantum computing contributing, the company is confident of maintaining solid growth into 2027.
