items.title: 馬斯克難攻印度市場 Starlink受阻將如何影響SpaceX？
items.title_en: Musk Finds Indian Market Hard to Crack; How Will Starlink Setbacks Affect SpaceX?
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周四(8日)走低，投資人正在評估Starlink在印度市場擴張所面臨的阻礙。
馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下火箭與人工智慧公司SpaceX股價下跌4.2%，收在160.57美元。標普500指數下跌0.5%，道瓊工業指數則上漲0.1%。SpaceX周四股價下跌前，才剛經歷幾個強勁的交易日，此前10月1日收盤時仍低於150美元。
周四的股價走勢，源自馬斯克周三在社群平台X發表的一則貼文。他指控「某些寡頭」試圖維持「對印度人民的壟斷性控制」。
馬斯克表示，印度當地網路服務業者，包括Reliance Jio與Bharti Airtel，正讓Starlink難以在該國推出服務。
Starlink是SpaceX的衛星寬頻服務，目前已在超過160個國家提供服務。截至第二季末，Starlink約有1,200萬名訂戶。
然而，Starlink要運作仍需要無線電頻譜來傳送訊號。就像同一地區的兩個廣播電台無法使用相同頻率進行廣播一樣，無線數據服務商也需要各自的頻譜來傳輸資訊。目前Starlink仍在等待印度核發衛星頻譜。
對投資人而言，監管延誤或競爭對手網路業者採取的行動，都可能成為SpaceX成長的潛在阻力。
預計Starlink第三季營收將達約48億美元，高於第二季的43億美元。
德意志銀行分析師Edison Yu近期在報告中寫道，「截至9月底，全球消費者訂戶數預估達1,350萬，9月單月淨新增訂戶超過37萬。」
他表示，「北美市場以550萬名訂戶居首，占整體訂戶數的41%，9月單月新增12.6萬名訂戶。」
就目前而言，即使沒有印度市場，SpaceX仍擁有相當大的成長空間。
投資人將在幾周後SpaceX公布第三季財報時，取得更準確的Starlink訂戶數量與業務最新進展。預計SpaceX單季AI業務營收將首次超越Starlink。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that SpaceX (SPCX-US) shares fell on Thursday the 8th as investors assess the obstacles Starlink faces in expanding into the Indian market.

Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company SpaceX saw its stock drop 4.2% to $160.57. The S&P 500 fell 0.5% while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.1%. The decline came after a few strong trading days, with the stock still below $150 at the close on Oct. 1.

The Thursday price move was triggered by a post Musk made on the social platform X on Wednesday, in which he accused “certain oligarchs” of trying to maintain “monopolistic control over the Indian people.”
Musk said that local Indian internet service providers, including Reliance Jio and Bharti Airtel, are making it difficult for Starlink to launch services in the country.
Starlink is SpaceX’s satellite broadband service, now operating in more than 160 countries. By the end of Q2 it had roughly 12 million subscribers.

However, Starlink still needs radio spectrum to transmit signals. Just as two radio stations in the same area cannot use the same frequency, broadband providers need separate spectrum allocations. Starlink is still waiting for India to allocate satellite spectrum.
For investors, regulatory delays or actions taken by competing network operators could become potential headwinds to SpaceX’s growth.
Starlink’s Q3 revenue is projected to reach about $4.8 billion, up from $4.3 billion in Q2.

Deutsche Bank analyst Edison Yu wrote in a recent note that global consumer subscriber numbers are estimated at 13.5 million by the end of September, with more than 370,000 net new subscribers added in September alone.
He added that the North American market leads with 5.5 million subscribers, accounting for 41% of the total, and added 126,000 new subscribers in September.
At present, even without the Indian market, SpaceX still has substantial growth potential.

Investors will get a clearer picture of Starlink’s subscriber count and business progress when SpaceX releases its Q3 earnings in a few weeks, with AI revenue expected to surpass Starlink’s for the first time in a single quarter.

items.title: 西南航空傳考慮採購數十架波音787 長程國際布局最快3年啟動
items.title_en: Southwest Airlines Considers Purchasing Dozens of Boeing 787s for Long-Haul International Expansion Within Three Years
paras: 美國廉價航空公司西南航空 (Southwest Airlines) (LUV-US) 正評估採購波音 (BA-US) 787夢幻客機 (Dreamliner)，作為拓展長程國際航線的首款廣體客機。3名知情人士透露，西南航空正考慮在未來約3年內推出長程國際航班，並研究透過租賃公司或二手飛機市場取得客機，以縮短機隊部署時間。不過，目前尚未做出最終機型決定，相關計畫仍須經公司董事會審議。
知情人士表示，西南航空曾考慮引進數十架787客機，但目前尚不清楚公司考慮的是哪一種787機型，也無法確認是否已經洽談或簽訂租賃安排。西南航空去年成立機隊監督委員會，協助監督機隊採購策略，最終機型選擇仍將由董事會決定。
西南航空財務長Tom Doxey今年9月曾表示，長程國際航線是公司正在評估的多項發展選項之一，但當時並未宣布任何決策。公司此次也未直接回應是否考慮787，僅表示目前沒有即將公布的機隊計畫消息。波音則將相關問題轉交西南航空回應，歐洲飛機製造商空中巴士 (Airbus, AIR-FR) 表示，不評論與航空公司的洽談內容。
若西南航空決定採用787，將代表公司機隊策略進入新階段。目前西南航空全數使用波音737系列窄體客機，尚未營運廣體客機。引進787不僅可讓公司開闢更長程的國際航線，也將使其與美國大型航空公司在跨洲航線市場直接競爭。
西南航空近年正逐步調整產品與營運策略，以吸引願意支付較高票價的旅客。公司已推出指定座位及額外腿部空間座位，並宣布計畫設立機場貴賓室及推出高端信用卡產品，希望擴大高收益客群，強化常客獎勵計畫Rapid Rewards及聯名信用卡業務。
執行長Bob Jordan先前表示，西南航空並不需要建立與達美航空 (DAL-US)、聯合航空 (UAL-US) 或美國航空 (AAL-US) 規模相當的長程國際網絡。今年5月，他指出，約8至12個長程目的地，就可能涵蓋多數西南航空客戶希望前往的地點。這顯示公司目前考慮的是有選擇性的長程擴張，而非全面複製大型航空公司的全球航線網絡。
在機型選擇方面，空中巴士也積極爭取西南航空的未來訂單。知情人士表示，空中巴士A321XLR與A330neo都可能滿足公司的部分長程需求，較小型的A220則被推介用於其他航線布局。不過，若選擇空中巴士，西南航空將必須打破目前全波音機隊的配置，增加新的飛機製造商與機型。
相較之下，787在目前討論中似乎更具優勢。西南航空飛行員工會主席Jody Reven近期在工會播客節目中透露，公司曾討論「大型客機」與「長程窄體客機」兩種方向，顯示航空公司仍在評估不同的機隊發展方案。
飛機交付時程將是決定長程航線何時啟動的重要因素。知情人士指出，西南航空討論的長程擴張時間表約為3年，但波音787目前的供應相當緊張。波音已表示，787客機的訂單交付時段已排滿至本世紀末，這可能限制西南航空直接訂購新機後投入營運的速度。
為了加快啟動長程航線，西南航空已研究向飛機租賃公司取得787，或從二手飛機市場購入客機，作為初期機隊的一部分。不過，目前尚無已確定的租賃或採購安排。
引進787也將帶來新的營運挑戰。西南航空過去已表示，新增機型需要建立相應的維修及訓練制度，取得監管機關批准，並與工會協商薪酬及工作規則。廣體客機的營運方式與現有737機隊不同，相關準備工作可能增加成本與執行複雜度。
西南航空若最終採用787，將是公司從以美國國內及短中程航線為主的營運模式，進一步拓展至長程國際市場的重要轉變。後續仍須觀察董事會決策、飛機供應與取得時程，以及公司是否能在不大幅增加營運複雜度的情況下，透過有限數量的長程目的地擴大收入來源。
paras_en: Southwest Airlines (LUV-US), the U.S. low‑cost carrier, is evaluating the purchase of Boeing (BA-US) 787 Dreamliners as its first wide‑body aircraft to support a long‑haul international network. Three sources said Southwest is looking at launching long‑haul international routes in roughly three years and is studying leasing or second‑hand markets to acquire aircraft faster, though no final type decision has been made and the plan still requires board approval.

The sources said Southwest has considered acquiring dozens of 787s, but it is unclear which 787 variant is being contemplated and whether any lease negotiations or agreements have been reached. Southwest set up a fleet oversight committee last year to monitor its acquisition strategy, with the ultimate aircraft choice still to be decided by the board.

Chief Financial Officer Tom Doxey told investors in September that long‑haul international routes are one of several options under review, but no decision was announced at the time. Southwest did not directly comment on whether it is considering the 787, saying there are no fleet announcements pending. Boeing redirected related questions back to Southwest, while Airbus (AIR-FR) declined to comment on any airline talks.

If Southwest adopts the 787, it would mark a new phase in its fleet strategy. The airline currently operates an all‑Boeing 737 narrow‑body fleet and has never flown a wide‑body. Adding the 787 would enable longer international routes and put Southwest in direct competition with the major U.S. carriers on intercontinental markets.

Southwest has been gradually adjusting its product and operations to attract higher‑fare passengers. It has introduced assigned seating and extra‑legroom seats, announced plans for airport lounges and premium credit‑card products, and aims to grow high‑yield customers while strengthening its Rapid Rewards loyalty program and co‑branded card business.

CEO Bob Jordan previously said Southwest does not need to build a long‑haul network as large as Delta (DAL-US), United (UAL-US) or American (AAL-US). In May he noted that about eight to twelve long‑haul destinations could cover most of Southwest’s customers’ desired locations, indicating a selective rather than a full‑scale global expansion.

In terms of aircraft choice, Airbus is also courting Southwest’s future orders. Sources said the A321XLR and A330neo could meet parts of the airline’s long‑haul needs, while the smaller A220 is being pitched for other route structures. Choosing Airbus would require Southwest to break its all‑Boeing fleet composition and add a new manufacturer.

By contrast, the 787 appears to have an edge in current discussions. Southwest pilots’ union chair Jody Reven recently revealed on a union podcast that the airline has debated both “large aircraft” and “long‑haul narrow‑body” options, showing that multiple fleet development paths are still being weighed.

Aircraft delivery timelines will be a key factor in when long‑haul routes can launch. Sources said Southwest’s expansion timeline is about three years, but Boeing’s 787 supply is tight. Boeing has indicated its 787 delivery slots are filled through the end of the century, which could limit how quickly Southwest could put new jets into service after a direct purchase.

To accelerate the start of long‑haul service, Southwest has looked at obtaining 787s from leasing firms or buying used aircraft as an initial fleet component. However, no lease or purchase agreements have been confirmed yet.

Introducing the 787 would also bring new operational challenges. Southwest has previously said that adding a new type requires building maintenance and training programs, obtaining regulator approval, and negotiating union pay and work rules. Operating a wide‑body differs from its existing 737 fleet and could raise costs and complexity.

If Southwest ultimately adopts the 787, it would represent a major shift from a domestic, short‑ to medium‑haul model to a long‑haul international focus. Future developments will depend on board decisions, aircraft availability and acquisition timing, and whether the airline can expand revenue with a limited number of long‑haul destinations without substantially increasing operational complexity.

items.title: 荷蘭飲料製造商Refresco擬上市 美歐成潛在掛牌地點 KKR持股企業估值看逾100億美元
items.title_en: Dutch Beverage Manufacturer Refresco Plans IPO, US and Europe as Potential Listing Locations, KKR-Owned Firm Valued at Over $10 Billion
paras: 荷蘭飲料製造商 Refresco 傳出正評估首次公開募股(IPO)計畫，目標估值可能超過100億美元。知情人士透露，Refresco 與其所有者私募股權投資公司 KKR (KKR-US) 近期已聽取多家投資銀行的提案，評估銀行在潛在上市案中擔任承銷等相關角色的可能性，上市地點則考慮美國或歐洲。
知情人士表示，若上市計畫順利推進，Refresco 的市場估值可能超過100億美元。不過，目前相關規劃仍處於初步階段，後續可能調整。Refresco 與 KKR 均拒絕對此置評。
KKR 於2022年透過旗下全球基礎建設投資策略，以約80億美元收購 Refresco。這項投資策略主要布局關鍵基礎設施資產，其他投資領域包括公用事業、能源及通訊服務。若 Refresco 最終以逾100億美元估值上市，將高於 KKR 當年的收購價格，但實際估值仍須視市場環境、投資人需求及上市條件而定。
Refresco 成立於1999年，總部位於荷蘭鹿特丹，自稱是全球最大的獨立飲料製造商。公司主要為零售商及品牌飲料企業提供飲料生產、裝瓶、倉儲、物流與配送服務，業務涵蓋北美、歐洲及澳洲，目前在全球擁有85座生產設施。
在零售通路方面，Refresco 與沃爾瑪 (WMT-US) 及 Aldi 等零售商合作，生產自有品牌飲料；在品牌飲料業務方面，合作對象則包括可口可樂 (KO-US)、百事公司 (PEP-US) 及魔爪飲料 (MNST-US) 等企業。這種同時服務零售商自有品牌與大型飲料品牌的商業模式，使 Refresco 在飲料供應鏈中扮演製造及生產服務商的角色。
根據 Refresco 年報，公司2025年營收接近70億美元，調整後息稅折舊攤銷前獲利(EBITDA)約9.3億美元。這些財務數據將是投資人評估潛在上市估值的重要依據。
市場可比較的企業之一，是總部位於美國北卡羅來納州的 Coca-Cola Consolidated (COKE-US)。該公司主要從事可口可樂產品相關業務，與 Refresco 的營運模式並不完全相同，但知情人士認為，仍可作為評估 Refresco 估值的參考對象。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)的數據，Coca-Cola Consolidated 市值約125億美元，企業估值相當於接近12倍 EBITDA。投資人可藉此衡量飲料製造與供應鏈服務企業的市場估值，但不同公司的品牌組合、客戶結構及獲利模式仍可能造成估值差異。
Refresco 考慮上市之際，美國 IPO 市場今年初表現強勁。Dealogic 數據顯示，截至10月8日，2026年美國傳統 IPO 籌資金額已接近1,400億美元，市場原本預期全年有機會接近2021年的歷史高峰。
然而，近期市場波動加劇、債券殖利率走高、升息疑慮升溫，以及投資人對人工智慧支出與相關企業估值的質疑，都可能打亂原先預期熱絡的秋季 IPO 市場。對 Refresco 而言，即使企業營運規模與獲利能力具備一定基礎，最終能否以超過100億美元的估值上市，仍將受到資本市場環境及投資人對估值的接受程度影響。
paras_en: Dutch beverage manufacturer Refresco is reportedly evaluating an initial public offering (IPO) plan, with a target valuation that could exceed $10 billion. Sources say Refresco and its private‑equity owner KKR have recently heard proposals from several investment banks and are assessing the banks' potential underwriting roles, while considering the United States or Europe as possible listing venues.

Sources indicate that if the listing proceeds smoothly, Refresco’s market valuation could surpass $10 billion. However, the planning is still in an early stage and may be adjusted later. Both Refresco and KKR declined to comment on the matter.

KKR acquired Refresco in 2022 through its global infrastructure investment strategy for roughly $8 billion. The strategy focuses on key infrastructure assets, with other investments in utilities, energy and communications services. If Refresco eventually lists at a valuation above $10 billion, it would be higher than KKR’s purchase price, though the actual valuation will depend on market conditions, investor demand and listing terms.

Refresco was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. It describes itself as the world’s largest independent beverage manufacturer. The company primarily provides production, bottling, warehousing, logistics and distribution services to retailers and branded‑beverage companies, operating across North America, Europe and Australia with 85 production facilities worldwide.

In the retail channel, Refresco partners with retailers such as Walmart and Aldi to produce private‑label drinks; on the branded side, it works with companies including Coca‑Cola, PepsiCo and Monster Beverage. This dual model of serving both retailer own‑brands and major beverage brands positions Refresco as a manufacturing and production service provider within the beverage supply chain.

According to Refresco’s annual report, the company’s 2025 revenue is projected to be close to $7 billion, with adjusted EBITDA of about $930 million. These financial figures will be key inputs for investors assessing a potential listing valuation.

One comparable public company is Coca‑Cola Consolidated, based in North Carolina, USA. While its business model differs from Refresco’s, insiders say it can still serve as a reference point for valuing Refresco.

LSEG data shows Coca‑Cola Consolidated has a market capitalization of roughly $12.5 billion, implying an enterprise value of about 12 times EBITDA. Investors can use this multiple to gauge valuations for beverage manufacturing and supply‑chain service firms, though differences in brand portfolios, customer bases and profit models can lead to valuation gaps.

Refresco’s listing considerations come as the U.S. IPO market has been strong early this year. Dealogic data indicates that as of October 8, 2026, U.S. traditional IPO proceeds have approached $140 billion, with expectations that the full‑year total could near the historic peak of 2021.

Nevertheless, heightened market volatility, rising bond yields, mounting rate‑hike concerns, and investor scepticism about AI‑related spending and valuations could disrupt the anticipated lively autumn IPO season. For Refresco, even with solid operational scale and profitability, achieving a valuation above $10 billion will ultimately depend on capital‑market conditions and investor appetite for the price.

items.title: OpenAI營收消息震撼AI產業  較先前報導低200億美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Revenue News Shocks AI Industry, $20 Billion Lower Than Earlier Reports
paras: 《金融時報》(Financial Times) 週四 (8日) 率先引述與投資人分享的財務文件披露，截至 9 月，OpenAI 年化營收約為 500 億美元，低於先前部分媒體報導的約 700 億美元。截稿前，OpenAI 拒絕置評。
知情人士指出，先前較高的數字，源於投資人試圖直接比較 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的營收規模。Anthropic 將透過亞馬遜 AWS、Google Cloud 等雲端合作夥伴產生的銷售收入計入營收，OpenAI 則未採用相同方式。
投資人先前調整 OpenAI 的營收計算，估算其 8 月年化營收達到 400 億美元，之後再結合公司向投資人披露的營收成長超過 70% 資訊，推算出約 700 億美元的規模。
年化營收規模有時是容易造成誤解的銷售指標，通常以單月營收乘以 12 計算，並非實際全年營收。不過，這仍已成為矽谷快速成長新創公司普遍採用的熱門指標。
由於OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兩家公司計算方式不同，相關數字也不能直接視為相同基準下的比較。
依報導列出的數字，OpenAI 年化營收接近 500 億美元，低於 Anthropic 約 650 億美元的規模。
兩家公司正積極爭取企業客戶，推出程式設計及通用型 AI 代理產品。OpenAI 上週舉行年度開發者大會，發布面向企業工作者的 Dots AI 代理，以及最新模型 GPT-6.1 Sol。
市場也持續關注兩家公司的上市計畫。OpenAI 預期可能於 2027 年初啟動首次公開發行 (IPO)，Anthropic 則傳出可能在今年感恩節前上市，公開版 S-1 招股文件有望近期公布，惟相關時程仍未正式確認。
paras_en: Financial Times reported on Thursday (the 8th) that, citing financial documents shared with investors, OpenAI’s annualized revenue as of September was about $50 billion, lower than the roughly $70 billion reported by some media earlier. OpenAI declined to comment before the deadline.

Sources said the higher earlier figure stemmed from investors trying to compare OpenAI directly with Anthropic’s revenue. Anthropic counts sales revenue generated through cloud partners such as Amazon AWS and Google Cloud, whereas OpenAI does not use the same method.

Investors had previously adjusted OpenAI’s revenue calculation, estimating its August annualized revenue at $40 billion, and then combined that with the company’s disclosed revenue growth of over 70% to extrapolate a size of about $70 billion.

Annualized revenue can be a misleading sales metric, usually calculated by multiplying a single month’s revenue by 12 rather than reflecting actual full‑year revenue. Nonetheless, it has become a popular metric among fast‑growing Silicon Valley startups.
Because OpenAI and Anthropic use different calculation methods, the figures cannot be directly compared on the same basis.
Based on the numbers reported, OpenAI’s annualized revenue is close to $50 billion, lower than Anthropic’s roughly $65 billion scale.

Both companies are actively courting enterprise customers, launching programming and general‑purpose AI agent products. OpenAI held its annual developer conference last week, unveiling the Dots AI agent for business users and the latest model GPT‑6.1 Sol.

The market continues to watch the two firms’ IPO plans. OpenAI may launch its IPO in early 2027, while Anthropic is rumored to go public before this year’s Thanksgiving, with a public S‑1 expected soon, though timelines are not officially confirmed.

items.title: 美光、SK海力士跌5%記憶體股倒一片 三星財測不如預期
items.title_en: Micron, SK Hynix Drop 5% as Memory Stocks Plunge; Samsung Forecast Misses Expectations
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，今年最熱門的AI交易之一，周四(8日)遭遇打擊。
記憶體與資料儲存類股走跌，此前三星電子(Samsung Electronics)公布的初步財測低於市場預期。
全球最大記憶體晶片製造商三星表示，預計第三季營收約為195兆韓元(1,450.6億美元)，營業利益約107.4兆韓元(798.9億美元)。根據Visible Alpha估計，分析師原本預期營收將達205.26兆韓元，營業利益為112.73兆韓元。
在消息公布後，SanDisk(SNDK-US)周四下跌4.9%，SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)大跌5%，希捷科技(Seagate Technology)(STX-US)下跌4.05%，美光(Micron)(MU-US)則下跌4.8%。Roundhill記憶體ETF(DRAM-US)下跌5.13%。三星電子在韓國交易所股價則下跌2.4%。
包括美光與SanDisk在內，多檔相關股票今年以來一直是標普500指數表現最強勁股票之一。AI需求蓬勃發展，推動這些公司的營收與獲利創下新高，但近期投資人開始質疑這波成長是否能夠持續。
分析師也警告，在市場已經抱持高度期待的情況下，記憶體類股這些漲幅驚人的股票，可能越來越難持續帶給投資人驚喜。
Coin Bureau分析師Nic Puckrin表示，「三星仍明顯維持驚人的成長，但如今龐大的數字已經無法再讓投資人感到驚艷。」
他指出，投資人可能正關注三星單季獲利成長速度放緩，並思考一旦記憶體晶片製造商在未來幾年提高供給，晶片價格將會出現什麼變化。
三星預計將於本月稍晚10月29日公布完整財報。
paras_en: Investopedia reported that one of the hottest AI trades of the year took a hit on Thursday (the 8th).
Memory and data storage stocks fell after Samsung Electronics released preliminary financial forecasts that fell short of market expectations.

The world’s largest memory chip manufacturer, Samsung, said it expects third‑quarter revenue of about 195 trillion won (US$145.06 billion) and operating profit of about 107.4 trillion won (US$79.89 billion). According to Visible Alpha estimates, analysts had originally expected revenue of 205.26 trillion won and operating profit of 112.73 trillion won.

After the announcement, SanDisk (SNDK‑US) fell 4.9% on Thursday, SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) plunged 5%, Seagate Technology (STX‑US) dropped 4.05%, and Micron (MU‑US) fell 4.8%. The Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM‑US) fell 5.13%, and Samsung Electronics’ share price on the Korean exchange fell 2.4%.

Including Micron and SanDisk, several related stocks have been among the strongest performers in the S&P 500 this year. The booming AI demand has driven these companies’ revenues and profits to new highs, but investors are beginning to question whether this growth can be sustained.
Analysts also warned that, given the high expectations already in the market, these spectacularly rising memory stocks may increasingly struggle to continue delivering surprises to investors.
Coin Bureau analyst Nic Puckrin said, “Samsung still clearly maintains impressive growth, but the massive numbers can no longer astonish investors.”

He pointed out that investors may be focusing on Samsung’s slowing quarterly profit growth rate and considering what will happen to chip prices if memory chip manufacturers increase supply in the coming years.
Samsung plans to release its full financial report later this month on October 29.

items.title: 2027年科技股買什麼？華爾街大多頭Dan Ives點名這五檔
items.title_en: What Tech Stocks to Buy in 2027? Wall Street Bull Dan Ives Names These Five
paras: 長期看好科技與AI龍頭股的華爾街明星分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives），公布了布局2027年的科技股首選。
艾夫斯在社群平台X發文，點名輝達(NVDA-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、Palantir(PLTR-US) 、蘋果(AAPL-US) 與蘋果(AAPL-US) 為布局2027年的首選科技股。
他指出，投資人低估了未來幾年這波4兆美元支出浪潮的規模與涵蓋範圍。
艾夫斯點名的這些名字並不陌生，因為他過去在韋德布希證券（Wedbush Securities）任職的8年間，就曾推薦這些公司。他當時擔任全球科技研究主管。
艾夫斯率領的團隊在最新發布的研究報告中表示：「AI革命在這個階段的發展，取決於供給，而非需求。我們認為，AI建設仍處於初期，對未來幾年科技贏家的前景持續高度樂觀。」
團隊指出，AI題材已不再只涉及單一產業，而是牽動「整體經濟的資本、電力與政策」。
艾夫斯最新看法出爐之際，「科技七巨頭」正從今年稍早的低迷中回升。這些股票周二(6日)助推標普500指數創下8月13日以來首度新高，Roundhill科技七巨頭ETF與那斯達克綜合指數則連續第二個交易日刷新收盤紀錄。
科技七巨頭包括Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 、蘋果(AAPL-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、Meta平台(META-US) 及特斯拉(TSLA-US) 。
艾夫斯及其團隊首次將49檔科技股納入研究範圍，其中Alphabet與蘋果的目標價均為每股400美元，亞馬遜為300美元、Meta為900美元、微軟為615美元、輝達為300美元、特斯拉為500美元，SpaceX則為225美元，上述股票均獲評「優於大盤」。
團隊預期，AI基礎設施的供給限制將「至少延續至2027年」，掌握稀缺算力、記憶體與電力的企業已開始受惠成長。企業軟體已經復甦，資安在資訊科技（IT）預算中的占比將持續提高，實體AI則成為最新發展領域。
軟銀也獲首次給予「優於大盤」評等，目標價為每股290美元；資安業者Crowdstrike(CRWD-US) 同樣獲評「優於大盤」，目標價為335美元。
艾夫斯是知名度最高、也最樂觀看待科技股的分析師之一，去年還推出色彩鮮明的服飾品牌。
他在2023年稱輝達執行長黃仁勳為「AI教父」，並以足球明星梅西為喻，稱Palantir為「AI界的梅西」。此後，這兩家公司的股價均大幅飆升。
在艾夫斯2026年推薦的股票中，CrowdStrike表現最佳，在市場擔憂AI模型能力過於強大的背景下，股價大漲138%。
其他股票的表現則反映出，科技股與AI投資今年走勢分歧、挑戰重重：蘋果上漲22%、微軟上漲9%、Palantir上漲8%，特斯拉下跌15%；輝達今年則上漲28%。
艾夫斯上月推出封閉式基金Ives Ultra AI Opportunities(IVAI-US) ，投資處於後期發展階段、尚未上市的AI與AI基礎設施公司。
此外，他名下還有兩檔ETF，分別是2025年推出的Dan IVES Wedbush AI Revolution ETF(IVES-US) ，以及今年稍早掛牌的Dan IVES Wedbush AI Power & Infrastructure ETF(IVEP-US) 。
paras_en: Long‑term bullish on technology and AI leaders, Wall Street star analyst Dan Ives announced his top picks for tech stocks to position for 2027.
Ives posted on X, naming Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Palantir (PLTR‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Apple (AAPL‑US) as his preferred tech stocks for 2027.
He said investors are underestimating the scale and scope of the upcoming $4 trillion spending wave over the next few years.
The names Ives highlighted are familiar, as during his eight‑year tenure at Wedbush Securities he repeatedly recommended these companies while serving as global head of technology research.

Ives’s team wrote in a newly released research report: “The AI revolution at this stage is driven by supply, not demand. We believe AI construction is still in its early phase and remain highly optimistic about the outlook for technology winners in the coming years.”
The team noted that AI themes now touch the entire economy’s capital, power and policy, no longer confined to a single industry.

As Ives’s latest view came out, the “Big Seven” tech stocks were rebounding from earlier this year’s slump. On Tuesday the 6th, those shares helped lift the S&P 500 to its first new high since August 13, while the Roundhill Tech Seven ETF and the Nasdaq Composite posted a second consecutive day of record closing levels.
The Big Seven comprise Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US).

Ives and his team included 49 tech stocks in their coverage for the first time, assigning target prices of $400 per share for both Alphabet and Apple, $300 for Amazon, $900 for Meta, $615 for Microsoft, $300 for Nvidia, $500 for Tesla, and $225 for SpaceX, with all of these stocks rated “outperform.”

The team expects supply constraints on AI infrastructure to “last at least until 2027,” and companies that control scarce compute, memory and power are already beginning to benefit. Enterprise software is recovering, cybersecurity’s share of IT budgets will keep rising, and physical AI is emerging as the newest growth area.
SoftBank also received an “outperform” rating for the first time, with a target price of $290 per share; cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US) was likewise rated “outperform” with a $335 target.
Ives is one of the most well‑known and optimistic tech‑stock analysts, and last year he even launched a brightly colored apparel brand.
In 2023 he called Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang the “AI godfather,” likening Palantir to soccer star Messi as the “Messi of AI,” after which both stocks surged dramatically.
Among the stocks Ives recommended in 2026, CrowdStrike performed best, jumping 138% as markets worried about overly powerful AI models.
The performance of other stocks reflected a divergent and challenging year for tech and AI investments: Apple rose 22%, Microsoft 9%, Palantir 8%, Tesla fell 15%, while Nvidia gained 28% this year.
Last month Ives launched the closed‑end fund Ives Ultra AI Opportunities (IVAI‑US), investing in late‑stage, pre‑IPO AI and AI‑infrastructure companies.
He also manages two ETFs: the Dan Ives Wedbush AI Revolution ETF (IVES‑US) launched in 2025, and the Dan Ives Wedbush AI Power & Infrastructure ETF (IVEP‑US) that listed earlier this year.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉OpenAI營收遭爆不如預期 AI概念股嚇趴 費半、台積電ADR重挫逾3%
items.title_en: <US After-Hours> OpenAI Revenue Misses Expectations, AI Stocks Plunge; FE Semiconductor and TSMC ADR Fall Over 3%
paras: OpenAI 營收遭爆低於先前傳聞，市場重新檢視 AI 投資回報，甲骨文、輝達等AI概念股集體承壓，美股那指週四 (8日) 收跌1.25%，費半重挫 3.39%，台積電ADR 同樣跌逾 3%，僅道瓊驚險收紅。
《金融時報》披露，人工智慧巨頭 OpenAI 向投資人揭露，9 月底年化營收約 500 億美元，低於先前報導的(約) 700 億美元，引發市場擔憂 AI 需求成長速度及龐大基礎建設支出的合理性。
此消息拖累 AI 概念股聞訊嚇跌。輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌約 3%、甲骨文 (ORCL-US) 崩近 6%、CoreWeave (CRWV-US) 狂瀉近 8%，Miller Tabak策略師Matt Maley表示，隨著借貸成本大幅上升，投資人開始質疑如此龐大的AI支出還能維持多久。
油價大漲也帶動能源股走強，雪佛龍 (CVX-US) 上揚3.15%。荷姆茲海峽船運遇襲，加上颶風影響美國石油產量，推升供應中斷疑慮。美國西德州原油期貨上漲3.64%，收每桶91.49美元；布蘭特原油高升4.07%，報每桶104.28美元。
川普稍早表示，美國不會在11月3日期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，促使油價自盤中高點回落，但供應緊張及中東局勢仍使能源價格維持高檔。
美債殖利率則呈現先升後降。美國 10 年期公債殖利率盤中一度升至約 5.35%，隨後回落至約 5.23%；30 年期殖利率也由約 5.73% 降至約 5.60%。美國財政部 30 年期公債標售需求穩健，帶動債券價格回升，緩解部分市場壓力。
聯準會理事華勒表示，未來可能仍需進一步升息，但決策時間具有彈性，不必連續在每次會議升息。聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩勒姆 (Alberto Musalem) 則認為，利率可能需要在未來6至9個月內進一步調升。
CME FedWatch工具顯示，市場目前普遍預期聯準會本月將按兵不動，但12月升息的機率已升至69.2%。
美股週四 (8 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭僅蘋果收紅。Meta (META-US) 下跌 0.06%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 上漲 1.11%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 0.63%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 1.35%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 2.25%。
主要半導體股普遍下跌。AMD (AMD-US) 下跌 3.90%；博通 (AVGO-US) 下跌 4.35%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 2.94%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 2.13%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 0.63%。
記憶體與儲存族群集體走低。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 4.79%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 下跌 2.99%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 4.90%；希捷 (STX-US) 下跌 4.05%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下跌 4.35%。
台股 ADR 跌多漲少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 3.01%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 下跌 1.09%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 2.10%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 0.92%。
企業新聞
Skydance (SKYD-US) 週四勁揚 4.39% 至每股 9.28 美元。派拉蒙與華納兄弟探索集團於6號正式宣布完成合併，迎來估值高達約3.5兆台幣的超級媒體巨獸「天舞集團」，共同執行長艾里森 (David Ellison) 接受訪問時表示，這家媒體巨頭「在所有業務領域都具備勝出的條件」。
半導體製造商格芯 (GlobalFoundries；格羅方德) (GFS-US) 收高2.68% 至每股 49.36 美元。公司宣布與台積電 (TSM-US、2330-TW) 達成一項總值 20 億美元的多年製造協議，將生產矽中介層，預計於 2028 年上半年開始量產。
《金融時報》報導，星巴克曾探討收購墨西哥捲餅連鎖餐飲業者 Chipotle 的可能性。Chipotle (CMG-US) 猛升6.21%、星巴克 (SBUX-US) 收低0.40%。
晶片業者博通 (AVGO-US) 跳水超 4% 至每股 360.14 美元。據《華爾街日報》報導，博通正籌措超過 500 億美元的融資，資金用途與其攜手 OpenAI 開發的客製化 AI 晶片有關。
華爾街分析
Baird投資策略師Ross Mayfield表示，能源價格帶來的通膨壓力，已改變聯準會政策傾向，同時推升長天期美債殖利率。若美國與伊朗達成具實質內容的協議，使油價從每桶90美元降至70美元，殖利率可能明顯回落。他預期，美債殖利率可能穩定在5%至6%區間，但若進一步攀升，將對股市構成更大壓力。
D.A. Davidson科技研究主管Gil Luria則不擔心OpenAI營收低於先前預期。他指出，OpenAI本季營收成長速度有所加快，在企業市場也逐漸追上Anthropic，兩家公司合計年化營收規模已達約1,200億美元，顯示企業與消費者確實願意為AI服務付費。
富國銀行投資研究院全球投資策略分析師Tony Miano表示，週四美國30年期公債標售結果雖不如前一日的10年期公債標售，但整體需求並未崩潰。投資人只是要求更高的長天期風險補償，反映期限溢酬及存續期間風險升高，也釋出殖利率曲線趨陡訊號。
瑞銀全球財富管理投資總監辦公室策略師Ulrike Hoffmann-Burchardi仍看好AI長期成長前景，但提醒市場漲勢日益集中於少數大型科技股。AI投資回報、融資及執行能力仍存在疑問，在資金成本偏高的環境下，可能持續引發市場波動。
U.S. Bank Wealth Management股票策略師Terry Sandven表示，市場正在第三季財報季登場前盤整，中東衝突及油價上漲也壓抑風險偏好，但今年以來美股阻力最小的方向仍是向上。

paras_en: OpenAI’s revenue came in far below earlier rumors, prompting the market to reassess AI investment returns. AI‑related stocks such as Oracle and Nvidia came under pressure, and the Nasdaq fell 1.25% on Thursday (the 8th). The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tumbled 3.39% and TSMC ADR also slipped more than 3%, while the Dow managed a narrow gain.

The Financial Times disclosed that AI giant OpenAI told investors its annualized revenue at the end of September was about $50 billion, well below the previously reported roughly $70 billion, sparking concerns about the pace of AI demand growth and the justification for massive infrastructure spending.

The news dragged down AI‑related equities. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) fell about 3%, Oracle (ORCL‑US) dropped nearly 6%, CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) plunged almost 8%. Miller Tabak strategist Matt Maley said that as borrowing costs have risen sharply, investors are questioning how long such huge AI spending can be sustained.

Rising oil prices also boosted energy stocks, with Chevron (CVX‑US) up 3.15%. Disruptions in the Hormuz Strait shipping lane and a hurricane affecting U.S. oil output heightened supply‑concern fears. West Texas Intermediate crude rose 3.64% to $91.49 a barrel, while Brent jumped 4.07% to $104.28 a barrel.

President Trump earlier said the United States would not attack Iran before the November 3 primary election, causing oil prices to retreat from intraday highs, but tight supplies and Middle‑East tensions kept energy prices elevated.

U.S. Treasury yields showed a rise‑then‑fall pattern. The 10‑year yield briefly hit about 5.35% before easing to roughly 5.23%; the 30‑year fell from around 5.73% to about 5.60%. Strong demand for the Treasury’s 30‑year auction lifted bond prices and eased some market pressure.

Federal Reserve Governor Waller said further rate hikes may still be needed, but the timing is flexible and not necessarily at every meeting. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem believes rates could rise again over the next 6‑9 months.
The CME FedWatch tool shows markets largely expect the Fed to hold rates steady this month, but the probability of a December hike has risen to 69.2%.
U.S. equity markets on Thursday (the 8th) posted the following index moves:

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 51.77 points, or 0.10%, to 51,231.64. The Nasdaq fell 345.35 points, or 1.25%, to 27,193.34. The S&P 500 slipped 36.41 points, or 0.47%, to 7,765.36. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index plunged 442.44 points, or 3.39%, to 12,623.72. The NYSE FANG+ Index dropped 221.47 points, or 1.13%, to 19,427.50.

Among the five big‑tech names in the NYSE FANG+ index, only Apple posted a gain. Meta (META‑US) fell 0.06%; Apple (AAPL‑US) rose 1.11%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) slipped 0.63%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) fell 1.35%; Amazon (AMZN‑US) dropped 2.25%.

Major semiconductor stocks were broadly lower. AMD (AMD‑US) fell 3.90%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) dropped 4.35%; Nvidia (NVDA‑US) slid 2.94%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) fell 2.13%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) slipped 0.63%.

Memory and storage stocks all moved lower. Micron (MU‑US) fell 4.79%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) dropped 2.99%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) slid 4.90%; Seagate (STX‑US) fell 4.05%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) declined 4.35%.
Taiwan‑related ADRs saw more declines than gains. TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) fell 3.01%; ASE Technology ADR (ASX‑US) dropped 1.09%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) slid 2.10%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) rose 0.92%.
Corporate news

Skydance (SKYD‑US) surged 4.39% on Thursday to $9.28 a share. Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery announced on the 6th that they completed a merger, creating a super‑media entity valued at roughly NT$3.5 trillion called “Tianwu Group.” Co‑CEO David Ellison said the new media giant “has winning attributes across all business lines.”

Semiconductor manufacturer GlobalFoundries (GFS‑US) rose 2.68% to $49.36 a share after announcing a multi‑year manufacturing agreement worth $2 billion with TSMC (TSM‑US, 2330‑TW) to produce silicon interposers, slated for volume production in the first half of 2028.
The Financial Times reported that Starbucks had explored a possible acquisition of Mexican fast‑casual chain Chipotle. Chipotle (CMG‑US) jumped 6.21% while Starbucks (SBUX‑US) fell 0.40%.
Broadcom (AVGO‑US) plunged more than 4% to $360.14 a share. The Wall Street Journal said Broadcom is raising over $50 billion in financing tied to its custom AI chips being developed with OpenAI.
Wall Street analysis

Baird strategist Ross Mayfield said inflation pressure from energy prices has shifted the Fed’s policy tilt and pushed long‑term Treasury yields higher. If the U.S. reaches a substantive agreement with Iran that brings oil down from $90 to $70 a barrel, yields could fall noticeably. He expects Treasury yields to settle in the 5%‑6% range, but further rises would weigh on equities.

D.A. Davidson technology research head Gil Luria is not worried about OpenAI’s revenue miss. He noted that OpenAI’s quarterly revenue growth has accelerated and that it is closing the gap with Anthropic in the enterprise market; together the two firms now generate roughly $120 billion in annualized revenue, showing that both businesses and consumers are willing to pay for AI services.

Wells Fargo Global Investment Strategy analyst Tony Miano said Thursday’s 30‑year Treasury auction was weaker than the previous day’s 10‑year auction, but overall demand did not collapse. Investors are simply asking for higher long‑term risk premiums, reflecting higher term‑premium and duration risk, and signaling a steeper yield curve.

UBS Global Wealth Management investment director Ulrike Hoffmann‑Burchardi remains bullish on AI’s long‑term growth prospects but cautions that the rally is becoming increasingly concentrated in a few large tech stocks. She says questions remain about AI investment returns, financing and execution capability, and that high funding costs could keep market volatility elevated.

U.S. Bank Wealth Management equity strategist Terry Sandven noted the market is consolidating ahead of the Q3 earnings season, with Middle‑East conflict and rising oil prices dampening risk appetite, yet the path of least resistance for U.S. equities this year remains upward.

items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Weakens, European Government Bond Yields Retreat from Peaks
paras: 美元周四(8日)走弱，歐元區公債殖利率的升勢暫歇，而市場對聯準會(Fed)今年利率走向的預期大致維持不變。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報102.17，此前一度升至102.46。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.1204美元，盤中一度跌至1.1171美元。
歐元區政府公債殖利率再度大幅上升，油價飆漲加劇通膨疑慮，投資人持續拋售法國、義大利等高負債國家的公債。
不過，隨著殖利率升勢逐漸降溫，歐元也從盤中低點回升。法國10年期公債殖利率上升2.7個基點至4.8873%，盤中一度攀升至4.9685%。
在投資人密切檢視法國的債務規模、預算赤字，以及2027年總統大選前的政治前景之際，法國受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
西班牙方面，工會周三宣布將於11月11日發動全國性總罷工，抗議住宅問題，而這場示威距離提前舉行的大選僅剩數周。
Fed釋放升息謹慎訊號
市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍偏低。聯準會周三公布最新一次會議紀要後，顯示決策官員認為通膨是經濟展望面臨的最大風險，分析師則表示，會議紀要並未帶來意外訊號。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，為了讓通膨降至聯準會2%的目標，未來可能仍需要進一步升息，但他也表示升息步調具「彈性」，並為即將舉行的10月會議暫停升息留下空間。
華勒的言論呼應了部分聯準會官員上周的說法，他們均釋放出希望在進一步升息上保持耐心的訊號。
SimCorp多資產投資決策研究主管Christoph Schon表示，「多數其他貨幣似乎都與其貨幣政策預期呈反向關係，但那是因為過去一切都受到美元和聯準會主導，而這種情況在過去幾周仍持續存在。」
「有趣的是，現在還有另一個影響歐元的因素，也就是法國、如今甚至西班牙的政治危機……因此，這是一段短暫的時期，焦點不在利率差或貨幣政策，而是一場非常特殊的歐元危機，而在這個案例中，它正影響歐元。」
市場押注12月升息
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會本月升息至少25個基點的機率僅17.2%，略低於一周前的24.4%。不過，投資人押注12月會議升息的機率則達到81.2%。
在華勒發表上述評論後，高盛分析師在報告中表示，他們仍預期聯準會12月將再升息25個基點，並下調12月不升息的機率，因為華勒的言論代表政策立場轉向更加鷹派。
在更為鷹派的談話中，聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩林(Alberto Musalem)表示，美國央行需要再次升息，才能讓通膨回到2%的目標。
經濟數據方面，美國勞工部表示，上周初領失業金人數減少2,000人至19.7萬人，略低於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的20萬人。最新數據持續顯示美國就業市場保持穩定。
歐元區通膨可能高於目前已經偏高的預測，但歐洲央行(ECB)決策官員壓低了市場對短期升息的押注，多名官員周四表示，從基本面趨勢來看，情況其實較為溫和。
德國公債與法國、義大利等歐元區高負債國家公債之間不斷擴大的殖利率差距，已推動歐元跌至2024年5月以來最低水準。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.07%至1.3219美元，此前英國央行(BoE)總裁Andrew Bailey表示，全球債券市場受到高額借貸與不斷升高的通膨壓力衝擊之際，各國政府需要加倍努力，展現修復公共財政的能力。
美元兌日元下跌0.12%至157.88日元。日本銀行(BoJ)表示，原物料成本上升所帶動的價格漲勢正蔓延至消費品，部分企業提高價格的頻率也有所增加，顯示日銀對通膨壓力擴大的情況感到擔憂。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Thursday (the 8th), pausing the rise in Eurozone government bond yields, while market expectations for the Fed's rate path this year remained largely unchanged.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.08% to 102.17 after briefly climbing to 102.46.
The euro rose 0.08% against the dollar to $1.1204, after dipping intraday to $1.1171.
Eurozone sovereign yields surged again as oil price spikes heightened inflation concerns, prompting investors to continue selling bonds of heavily indebted countries such as France and Italy.
However, as the yield rally cooled, the euro recovered from its intraday low. France's 10‑year yield rose 2.7 basis points to 4.8873%, briefly reaching 4.9685% during the session.
The impact on France was especially pronounced as investors closely examined its debt size, budget deficit, and political outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
In Spain, unions announced on Wednesday a nationwide general strike on November 11 to protest housing issues, a protest taking place only weeks before an early election.
Fed signals cautious rate‑hike stance

Market expectations for a rate hike at the Fed's later policy meeting this month remain low. After the Fed released minutes of its latest meeting on Wednesday, officials said inflation remains the biggest risk to the economic outlook, and analysts said the minutes offered no surprise signals.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that further rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target, but he also noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible,” leaving room to pause at the upcoming October meeting.
Waller's comments echoed remarks from other Fed officials last week, who all signaled a desire to be patient on any further tightening.

Christoph Schon, head of multi‑asset investment decision research at SimCorp, said, “Most other currencies seem to move opposite to their monetary‑policy expectations, but that’s because everything has been dominated by the dollar and the Fed, and that situation has persisted over the past few weeks.”

“Interestingly, there is now another factor affecting the euro – the political crises in France and now even Spain… So this is a short‑term episode where the focus is not on rate differentials or policy, but on a very specific euro crisis that is currently influencing the currency,” he added.
Markets bet on a December hike

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 17.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points this month, down slightly from 24.4% a week ago. However, investors see an 81.2% chance of a hike at the December meeting.

After Waller’s remarks, a Goldman Sachs analyst wrote that they still expect a 25‑basis‑point hike in December and lowered the probability of no hike, interpreting Waller’s comments as a shift toward a more hawkish stance.
In an even more hawkish tone, Alberto Musalem, president of St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank, said the U.S. central bank needs another rate increase to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

On the data front, the U.S. Labor Department reported that initial unemployment claims fell by 2,000 to 197,000 last week, slightly below the Reuters poll forecast of 200,000, indicating the labor market remains stable.

Eurozone inflation may be higher than already elevated forecasts, but ECB policymakers have dampened market bets on a near‑term hike, with several officials on Thursday noting that, based on fundamentals, the situation is actually fairly moderate.
The widening yield gap between German bonds and those of high‑debt Eurozone members such as France and Italy has pushed the euro down to its lowest level since May 2024.

The pound rose 0.07% to $1.3219 after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that as global bond markets face high borrowing and rising inflation pressures, governments need to work harder to demonstrate fiscal repair capability.

The dollar fell 0.12% to ¥157.88. The Bank of Japan said rising raw‑material costs are feeding price increases into consumer goods, with some firms raising prices more frequently, showing the BOJ’s concern over expanding inflation pressures.

items.title: 馬斯克難攻印度市場 Starlink受阻將如何影響SpaceX？
items.title_en: Musk Finds Indian Market Hard to Crack; How Will Starlink Setbacks Affect SpaceX?
paras: 《巴隆周刊》報導，SpaceX(SPCX-US)股價周四(8日)走低，投資人正在評估Starlink在印度市場擴張所面臨的阻礙。
馬斯克(Elon Musk)旗下火箭與人工智慧公司SpaceX股價下跌4.2%，收在160.57美元。標普500指數下跌0.5%，道瓊工業指數則上漲0.1%。SpaceX周四股價下跌前，才剛經歷幾個強勁的交易日，此前10月1日收盤時仍低於150美元。
周四的股價走勢，源自馬斯克周三在社群平台X發表的一則貼文。他指控「某些寡頭」試圖維持「對印度人民的壟斷性控制」。
馬斯克表示，印度當地網路服務業者，包括Reliance Jio與Bharti Airtel，正讓Starlink難以在該國推出服務。
Starlink是SpaceX的衛星寬頻服務，目前已在超過160個國家提供服務。截至第二季末，Starlink約有1,200萬名訂戶。
然而，Starlink要運作仍需要無線電頻譜來傳送訊號。就像同一地區的兩個廣播電台無法使用相同頻率進行廣播一樣，無線數據服務商也需要各自的頻譜來傳輸資訊。目前Starlink仍在等待印度核發衛星頻譜。
對投資人而言，監管延誤或競爭對手網路業者採取的行動，都可能成為SpaceX成長的潛在阻力。
預計Starlink第三季營收將達約48億美元，高於第二季的43億美元。
德意志銀行分析師Edison Yu近期在報告中寫道，「截至9月底，全球消費者訂戶數預估達1,350萬，9月單月淨新增訂戶超過37萬。」
他表示，「北美市場以550萬名訂戶居首，占整體訂戶數的41%，9月單月新增12.6萬名訂戶。」
就目前而言，即使沒有印度市場，SpaceX仍擁有相當大的成長空間。
投資人將在幾周後SpaceX公布第三季財報時，取得更準確的Starlink訂戶數量與業務最新進展。預計SpaceX單季AI業務營收將首次超越Starlink。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported that SpaceX (SPCX-US) shares fell on Thursday the 8th as investors assess the obstacles Starlink faces in expanding into the Indian market.

Elon Musk’s rocket and AI company SpaceX saw its stock drop 4.2% to $160.57. The S&P 500 fell 0.5% while the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 0.1%. The decline came after a few strong trading days, with the stock still below $150 at the close on Oct. 1.

The Thursday price move was triggered by a post Musk made on the social platform X on Wednesday, in which he accused “certain oligarchs” of trying to maintain “monopolistic control over the Indian people.”
Musk said that local Indian internet service providers, including Reliance Jio and Bharti Airtel, are making it difficult for Starlink to launch services in the country.
Starlink is SpaceX’s satellite broadband service, now operating in more than 160 countries. By the end of Q2 it had roughly 12 million subscribers.

However, Starlink still needs radio spectrum to transmit signals. Just as two radio stations in the same area cannot use the same frequency, broadband providers need separate spectrum allocations. Starlink is still waiting for India to allocate satellite spectrum.
For investors, regulatory delays or actions taken by competing network operators could become potential headwinds to SpaceX’s growth.
Starlink’s Q3 revenue is projected to reach about $4.8 billion, up from $4.3 billion in Q2.

Deutsche Bank analyst Edison Yu wrote in a recent note that global consumer subscriber numbers are estimated at 13.5 million by the end of September, with more than 370,000 net new subscribers added in September alone.
He added that the North American market leads with 5.5 million subscribers, accounting for 41% of the total, and added 126,000 new subscribers in September.
At present, even without the Indian market, SpaceX still has substantial growth potential.

Investors will get a clearer picture of Starlink’s subscriber count and business progress when SpaceX releases its Q3 earnings in a few weeks, with AI revenue expected to surpass Starlink’s for the first time in a single quarter.

items.title: 西南航空傳考慮採購數十架波音787 長程國際布局最快3年啟動
items.title_en: Southwest Airlines Considers Purchasing Dozens of Boeing 787s for Long-Haul International Expansion Within Three Years
paras: 美國廉價航空公司西南航空 (Southwest Airlines) (LUV-US) 正評估採購波音 (BA-US) 787夢幻客機 (Dreamliner)，作為拓展長程國際航線的首款廣體客機。3名知情人士透露，西南航空正考慮在未來約3年內推出長程國際航班，並研究透過租賃公司或二手飛機市場取得客機，以縮短機隊部署時間。不過，目前尚未做出最終機型決定，相關計畫仍須經公司董事會審議。
知情人士表示，西南航空曾考慮引進數十架787客機，但目前尚不清楚公司考慮的是哪一種787機型，也無法確認是否已經洽談或簽訂租賃安排。西南航空去年成立機隊監督委員會，協助監督機隊採購策略，最終機型選擇仍將由董事會決定。
西南航空財務長Tom Doxey今年9月曾表示，長程國際航線是公司正在評估的多項發展選項之一，但當時並未宣布任何決策。公司此次也未直接回應是否考慮787，僅表示目前沒有即將公布的機隊計畫消息。波音則將相關問題轉交西南航空回應，歐洲飛機製造商空中巴士 (Airbus, AIR-FR) 表示，不評論與航空公司的洽談內容。
若西南航空決定採用787，將代表公司機隊策略進入新階段。目前西南航空全數使用波音737系列窄體客機，尚未營運廣體客機。引進787不僅可讓公司開闢更長程的國際航線，也將使其與美國大型航空公司在跨洲航線市場直接競爭。
西南航空近年正逐步調整產品與營運策略，以吸引願意支付較高票價的旅客。公司已推出指定座位及額外腿部空間座位，並宣布計畫設立機場貴賓室及推出高端信用卡產品，希望擴大高收益客群，強化常客獎勵計畫Rapid Rewards及聯名信用卡業務。
執行長Bob Jordan先前表示，西南航空並不需要建立與達美航空 (DAL-US)、聯合航空 (UAL-US) 或美國航空 (AAL-US) 規模相當的長程國際網絡。今年5月，他指出，約8至12個長程目的地，就可能涵蓋多數西南航空客戶希望前往的地點。這顯示公司目前考慮的是有選擇性的長程擴張，而非全面複製大型航空公司的全球航線網絡。
在機型選擇方面，空中巴士也積極爭取西南航空的未來訂單。知情人士表示，空中巴士A321XLR與A330neo都可能滿足公司的部分長程需求，較小型的A220則被推介用於其他航線布局。不過，若選擇空中巴士，西南航空將必須打破目前全波音機隊的配置，增加新的飛機製造商與機型。
相較之下，787在目前討論中似乎更具優勢。西南航空飛行員工會主席Jody Reven近期在工會播客節目中透露，公司曾討論「大型客機」與「長程窄體客機」兩種方向，顯示航空公司仍在評估不同的機隊發展方案。
飛機交付時程將是決定長程航線何時啟動的重要因素。知情人士指出，西南航空討論的長程擴張時間表約為3年，但波音787目前的供應相當緊張。波音已表示，787客機的訂單交付時段已排滿至本世紀末，這可能限制西南航空直接訂購新機後投入營運的速度。
為了加快啟動長程航線，西南航空已研究向飛機租賃公司取得787，或從二手飛機市場購入客機，作為初期機隊的一部分。不過，目前尚無已確定的租賃或採購安排。
引進787也將帶來新的營運挑戰。西南航空過去已表示，新增機型需要建立相應的維修及訓練制度，取得監管機關批准，並與工會協商薪酬及工作規則。廣體客機的營運方式與現有737機隊不同，相關準備工作可能增加成本與執行複雜度。
西南航空若最終採用787，將是公司從以美國國內及短中程航線為主的營運模式，進一步拓展至長程國際市場的重要轉變。後續仍須觀察董事會決策、飛機供應與取得時程，以及公司是否能在不大幅增加營運複雜度的情況下，透過有限數量的長程目的地擴大收入來源。
paras_en: Southwest Airlines (LUV-US), the U.S. low‑cost carrier, is evaluating the purchase of Boeing (BA-US) 787 Dreamliners as its first wide‑body aircraft to support a long‑haul international network. Three sources said Southwest is looking at launching long‑haul international routes in roughly three years and is studying leasing or second‑hand markets to acquire aircraft faster, though no final type decision has been made and the plan still requires board approval.

The sources said Southwest has considered acquiring dozens of 787s, but it is unclear which 787 variant is being contemplated and whether any lease negotiations or agreements have been reached. Southwest set up a fleet oversight committee last year to monitor its acquisition strategy, with the ultimate aircraft choice still to be decided by the board.

Chief Financial Officer Tom Doxey told investors in September that long‑haul international routes are one of several options under review, but no decision was announced at the time. Southwest did not directly comment on whether it is considering the 787, saying there are no fleet announcements pending. Boeing redirected related questions back to Southwest, while Airbus (AIR-FR) declined to comment on any airline talks.

If Southwest adopts the 787, it would mark a new phase in its fleet strategy. The airline currently operates an all‑Boeing 737 narrow‑body fleet and has never flown a wide‑body. Adding the 787 would enable longer international routes and put Southwest in direct competition with the major U.S. carriers on intercontinental markets.

Southwest has been gradually adjusting its product and operations to attract higher‑fare passengers. It has introduced assigned seating and extra‑legroom seats, announced plans for airport lounges and premium credit‑card products, and aims to grow high‑yield customers while strengthening its Rapid Rewards loyalty program and co‑branded card business.

CEO Bob Jordan previously said Southwest does not need to build a long‑haul network as large as Delta (DAL-US), United (UAL-US) or American (AAL-US). In May he noted that about eight to twelve long‑haul destinations could cover most of Southwest’s customers’ desired locations, indicating a selective rather than a full‑scale global expansion.

In terms of aircraft choice, Airbus is also courting Southwest’s future orders. Sources said the A321XLR and A330neo could meet parts of the airline’s long‑haul needs, while the smaller A220 is being pitched for other route structures. Choosing Airbus would require Southwest to break its all‑Boeing fleet composition and add a new manufacturer.

By contrast, the 787 appears to have an edge in current discussions. Southwest pilots’ union chair Jody Reven recently revealed on a union podcast that the airline has debated both “large aircraft” and “long‑haul narrow‑body” options, showing that multiple fleet development paths are still being weighed.

Aircraft delivery timelines will be a key factor in when long‑haul routes can launch. Sources said Southwest’s expansion timeline is about three years, but Boeing’s 787 supply is tight. Boeing has indicated its 787 delivery slots are filled through the end of the century, which could limit how quickly Southwest could put new jets into service after a direct purchase.

To accelerate the start of long‑haul service, Southwest has looked at obtaining 787s from leasing firms or buying used aircraft as an initial fleet component. However, no lease or purchase agreements have been confirmed yet.

Introducing the 787 would also bring new operational challenges. Southwest has previously said that adding a new type requires building maintenance and training programs, obtaining regulator approval, and negotiating union pay and work rules. Operating a wide‑body differs from its existing 737 fleet and could raise costs and complexity.

If Southwest ultimately adopts the 787, it would represent a major shift from a domestic, short‑ to medium‑haul model to a long‑haul international focus. Future developments will depend on board decisions, aircraft availability and acquisition timing, and whether the airline can expand revenue with a limited number of long‑haul destinations without substantially increasing operational complexity.

items.title: 賣了也沒賺！記憶體漲到三星也吃不消 手機第四季最高減產30%
items.title_en: No Profit Even When Sold! Memory Prices Soaring Beyond Samsung’s Capacity, Q4 Smartphone Production Cut Up to 30%
paras: 南韓媒體MoneyToday報導，三星電子(005930KS) 行動體驗（MX）部門已開始削減今年第四季產量，預計減幅最高達30%。此舉被解讀為因應假期旺季期間，記憶體價格大幅上漲，導致營業利益率惡化。
據多位資訊通訊（IT）產業消息人士透露，三星電子行動部門近期已要求合作夥伴將產品供應量減少20%至30%。因此，三星電子第四季智慧型手機產量預估將減少最多30%。
業界人士指出，記憶體與半導體成本上升，已讓部分手機陷入「賣一台虧一台」的困境。成本壓力加上傳統淡季，三星全年手機出貨量恐降至2億支出頭。
第四季供應量擬砍兩至三成
消息人士透露，三星此次縮減供應的幅度，明顯超出市場原先預期。市場研究機構IDC先前估計，三星第四季智慧型手機產量約為5,200萬支，較第三季減少約12%，但三星內部實際要求的削減幅度更大。
三星今年原本寄望Galaxy Z Fold8等新品熱銷，帶動全年出貨量達到約2.7億支。如今第四季供應量被曝將削減兩至三成，全年出貨目標也面臨下修壓力。
一名IT產業知情人士表示，記憶體與其他半導體價格上漲，已使三星部分智慧型手機銷售無利可圖。減產是公司維護整體獲利水準的主動措施，也反映手機業務承受的成本壓力。
手機記憶體一年漲175%
這波減產的主要原因，是智慧型手機使用的記憶體價格急劇攀升。
根據半導體市場研究機構TrendForce資料，今年第二季，12GB規格的手機用低功耗DRAM（LPDDR5X）價格介於145至146美元，較一年前大漲175%。第三季價格預估將再上漲約20%，最高可能觸及180美元。
價格上漲背後，是AI產業快速擴張帶來的記憶體需求。供應轉向利潤較高的AI相關產品，導致智慧型手機用記憶體供應吃緊，採購成本持續走高。
對三星手機業務而言，記憶體價格接連上漲，正侵蝕產品獲利。即使新品銷售帶動出貨，成本增加仍使部分產品面臨虧損，也促使公司透過減少供應量，維護整體利潤。
新機上市前觀望 第四季需求轉淡
除了零組件成本，季節性需求也是三星選擇在第四季減產的重要背景。
三星通常在每年1月至2月推出新品。隨著發表時間接近，部分消費者會延後購機，等待新款上市，使現有產品銷售放緩。
此外，集中帶動購機需求的畢業季與開學季，均落在第一季，第四季向來是三星智慧型手機銷售的相對淡季。當需求轉淡，又碰上記憶體成本居高不下，手機業務獲利壓力進一步加重。
此次削減供應量，反映三星在淡季需求與成本上升的雙重壓力下，選擇收縮生產規模，優先維護獲利水準。
全年出貨目標承壓 手機部門恐虧損
從全年出貨來看，第四季大幅減產，將衝擊三星原先設定的規模目標。
IDC資料顯示，三星今年第一季與第二季智慧型手機出貨量，分別為6,240萬支與6,270萬支，第三季預估約5,900萬支。
若第四季供應量按最大幅度削減，全年出貨量預計將降至2億支出頭，與原先約2.7億支的目標出現明顯落差。
手機部門的獲利表現也受到市場關注。檔案援引金融資訊機構FnGuide資料指出，市場已彙整三星第三季整體營業利益預估，但另有券商預測，MX部門可能出現營業虧損。
記憶體成本攀升，使三星手機業務面臨出貨與獲利的雙重壓力。第四季供應縮減幅度、全年出貨量，以及MX部門能否維持獲利，成為這波減產消息的主要焦點。
paras_en: South Korean media MoneyToday reported that Samsung Electronics (005930KS) Mobile Experience (MX) division has begun cutting its production for the fourth quarter of this year, with reductions of up to 30%. The move is seen as a response to a sharp rise in memory prices during the holiday peak season, which has hurt operating margins.

According to several IT‑industry sources, Samsung’s mobile division has recently asked its partners to lower product supply by 20% to 30%. As a result, Samsung’s fourth‑quarter smartphone output is expected to fall by as much as 30%.

Industry insiders note that rising memory and semiconductor costs have pushed some phones into a “lose money on every unit sold” situation. The cost pressure, combined with the traditional off‑season, could see Samsung’s total annual shipments dip to just over 200 million units.
Q4 supply slated to be cut by 20‑30%

Sources say Samsung’s supply cut this time far exceeds market expectations. Research firm IDC previously estimated Samsung’s Q4 smartphone production at about 52 million units, roughly a 12% drop from Q3, but Samsung’s internal reduction request is even larger.

Samsung had hoped this year that new models such as the Galaxy Z Fold 8 would drive sales to around 270 million units for the full year. With the Q4 supply now reported to be cut by 20‑30%, the annual shipment target is under pressure to be revised downward.

An IT‑industry insider said that the surge in memory and other semiconductor prices has made sales of some Samsung smartphones unprofitable. The cutback is a proactive step to protect overall profitability and reflects the cost pressure on the handset business.
Phone memory prices up 175% in a year
The main driver of the cutback is the sharp rise in memory prices used in smartphones.

According to semiconductor market research firm TrendForce, in Q2 this year the price of 12 GB low‑power DRAM (LPDDR5X) for phones ranged between $145 and $146, a 175% increase from a year earlier. Prices are expected to rise another ~20% in Q3, potentially reaching $180 at the high end.

The price surge is fueled by rapid AI industry expansion, which has boosted memory demand. Suppliers are shifting to higher‑margin AI‑related products, tightening supply for smartphone memory and pushing procurement costs higher.

For Samsung’s handset business, the consecutive memory price hikes are eroding product margins. Even if new‑model sales boost shipments, higher costs are making some models loss‑making, prompting the company to curb supply to protect overall profit.
Consumers wait for new releases, dampening Q4 demand
Beyond component costs, seasonal demand is another key factor behind Samsung’s decision to cut production in Q4.

Samsung typically launches new models between January and February each year. As the launch date approaches, some consumers postpone purchases to wait for the new devices, slowing sales of existing models.

Moreover, the graduation and back‑to‑school periods that normally drive phone purchases fall in Q1, making Q4 a relative off‑season for Samsung’s smartphones. When demand wanes and memory costs stay high, profit pressure on the handset business intensifies.
The supply reduction reflects Samsung’s choice to shrink production under the dual pressure of weak seasonal demand and rising costs, prioritising profit preservation.
Annual shipment target under pressure, handset division may incur losses
Looking at the full‑year shipments, a large Q4 cut will hit Samsung’s originally set volume target.
IDC data show Samsung shipped 62.4 million smartphones in Q1 and 62.7 million in Q2 of this year, with Q3 estimated at about 59 million units.
If Q4 supply is cut at the maximum rate, total annual shipments are projected to fall to just over 200 million units, a clear gap from the original ~270 million‑unit goal.

The handset division’s profit performance is also drawing market attention. Data from financial information provider FnGuide indicate that the market has compiled Samsung’s Q3 overall operating profit estimate, but some brokerages forecast that the MX division could post an operating loss.

Rising memory costs are putting Samsung’s handset business under dual pressure of shipment volume and profitability. The extent of the Q4 supply cut, the full‑year shipment outlook, and whether the MX division can maintain profit are the main focus of this production‑cut news.

items.title: 美債跌到能買了？大摩債券高手十年來首度翻多
items.title_en: U.S. Treasuries Drop to Buyable Levels? Morgan Stanley Bond Guru Turns Bullish for First Time in a Decade
paras: 摩根士丹利投資管理旗下績效優異的債券投資人坎杜賈（Vishal Khanduja），十年來首度轉為看好美債，認為處於逾二十年高點的殖利率，正對經濟成長形成制約。
坎杜賈與艾利斯（Brian Ellis）共同管理的伊頓萬斯總報酬債券基金，規模達41億美元，截至6月已將衡量利率風險的存續期間提高至6.07年，高於基準彭博美國綜合債券指數的5.8年。
擔任廣泛市場固定收益團隊主管的坎杜賈表示，這是該基金十多年來首次將存續期間配置提高至基準之上。
他本周接受訪問前，債市才經歷一波重挫。能源價格高漲、經濟韌性強勁及政府大舉舉債，加上企業為支應人工智慧（AI）投資而擴大借款，共同推升殖利率。
美國10年期公債殖利率自6月以來已上升約1個百分點，周三(7日)升至5.36%，再創24年新高。
坎杜賈表示，這波拋售仍可能讓殖利率再「超漲」10至15個基點，但目前的高殖利率已能提供足夠收益，緩衝債券價格進一步下跌的衝擊。
與此同時，借貸成本升高，已開始對全球經濟較脆弱的環節造成壓力，包括低收入消費者、高槓桿企業及負債沉重的政府。
2005年展開華爾街職涯的坎杜賈表示：「我們正控制布局的步調與規模。」他說，團隊正「緩慢但穩定地」利用殖利率超漲的機會，增加投資組合的殖利率曝險。「對未來12個月的展望，我非常、非常有信心。」
坎杜賈管理的基金過去十年年化報酬率達2.9%，超過彭博基準指數的兩倍，並在同期擊敗晨星評比中97%的同類基金。
不過，今年伊朗戰爭引發能源價格飆升，加劇通膨疑慮，該基金也與其他固定收益投資一同受挫。今年以來，基金約下跌2.8%，在同類基金中排名居中，跌幅與基準指數相當。
坎杜賈認為，殖利率升高、金融情勢收緊，加上聯準會立場更趨鷹派，已讓風險報酬條件轉向有利於拉長存續期間。
他的信心部分來自對聯準會的看法。聯準會上月進行三年來首次升息，並暗示接下來還會繼續調升利率。
他形容，聯準會是「強大的債券義警」，其抑制通膨的決心，最終將使經濟成長放緩，限制殖利率的上升空間。他指出，評等較低企業及法國等部分主權借款人的利差擴大，已反映金融情勢收緊。
他看好美債的另一個原因，是債券本身的報酬計算。根據彭博彙整的數據，投資人若以目前水準買進10年期美國公債，未來一年殖利率須升至約6%，債券價格下跌造成的損失才會抵銷利息收益。
「從評價來看，已開始變得極具吸引力。」他說：「我們正仔細尋找能帶動債市反彈、殖利率下滑的催化因素。」
paras_en: Vishal Khanduja, a top-performing bond investor at Morgan Stanley Investment Management, has turned bullish on U.S. Treasuries for the first time in ten years, arguing that yields, which are at a more than twenty‑year high, are now constraining economic growth.

The Eaton Vance Total Return Bond Fund that Khanduja co‑manages with Brian Ellis has $4.1 billion in assets and, as of June, has lengthened its duration measure of interest‑rate risk to 6.07 years, above the Bloomberg U.S. Aggregate Bond Index benchmark of 5.8 years.
Khanduja, who heads the broad‑market fixed‑income team, said this is the first time in more than a decade that the fund has set its duration allocation above the benchmark.

When he was interviewed earlier this week, the bond market had just endured a sharp sell‑off. Rising energy prices, resilient economic activity and massive government borrowing, together with companies increasing debt to fund AI investments, have all pushed yields higher.
The yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury has risen about one percentage point since June, reaching 5.36% on Wednesday the 7th, a fresh 24‑year high.
Khanduja said the sell‑off could still push yields another 10‑15 basis points higher, but the current high yields already provide enough income to cushion the impact of further bond‑price declines.

At the same time, higher borrowing costs are beginning to strain the more vulnerable parts of the global economy, including low‑income consumers, highly leveraged firms and heavily indebted governments.

Starting his Wall Street career in 2005, Khanduja said, “We are controlling the pace and scale of our positioning.” He added the team is “slowly but steadily” using the over‑shoot in yields to increase the portfolio’s yield exposure. “For the outlook over the next 12 months, I am very, very confident.”

Funds managed by Khanduja have delivered a 2.9% annualised return over the past ten years, more than twice the Bloomberg benchmark and beating 97% of peer funds in Morningstar’s rating during the same period.

However, this year’s surge in energy prices sparked by the Iran conflict has heightened inflation concerns, and the fund, like other fixed‑income investments, has suffered. Since the start of the year it is down about 2.8%, roughly in line with its benchmark and placing it in the middle of its peer group.
Khanduja believes that higher yields, tighter financial conditions and an increasingly hawkish Fed stance have shifted risk‑return dynamics in favour of extending duration.
Part of his confidence stems from his view of the Fed. The central bank raised rates last month – its first hike in three years – and signalled further increases are likely.

He described the Fed as a “powerful bond police,” saying its determination to curb inflation will ultimately slow growth and limit how far yields can climb. He noted that widening spreads for lower‑rated corporates and some sovereign borrowers such as France already reflect tighter financial conditions.

Another reason he likes U.S. Treasuries is the math of the bond’s return. Bloomberg data show that an investor buying a 10‑year Treasury at today’s level would need yields to rise to about 6% over the next year for the price loss to offset the interest earned.
“From a valuation perspective, they are becoming extremely attractive,” he said. “We are carefully looking for catalysts that could spark a bond‑market rally and push yields lower.”

items.title: 荷蘭飲料製造商Refresco擬上市 美歐成潛在掛牌地點 KKR持股企業估值看逾100億美元
items.title_en: Dutch Beverage Manufacturer Refresco Plans IPO, US and Europe as Potential Listing Locations, KKR-Owned Firm Valued at Over $10 Billion
paras: 荷蘭飲料製造商 Refresco 傳出正評估首次公開募股(IPO)計畫，目標估值可能超過100億美元。知情人士透露，Refresco 與其所有者私募股權投資公司 KKR (KKR-US) 近期已聽取多家投資銀行的提案，評估銀行在潛在上市案中擔任承銷等相關角色的可能性，上市地點則考慮美國或歐洲。
知情人士表示，若上市計畫順利推進，Refresco 的市場估值可能超過100億美元。不過，目前相關規劃仍處於初步階段，後續可能調整。Refresco 與 KKR 均拒絕對此置評。
KKR 於2022年透過旗下全球基礎建設投資策略，以約80億美元收購 Refresco。這項投資策略主要布局關鍵基礎設施資產，其他投資領域包括公用事業、能源及通訊服務。若 Refresco 最終以逾100億美元估值上市，將高於 KKR 當年的收購價格，但實際估值仍須視市場環境、投資人需求及上市條件而定。
Refresco 成立於1999年，總部位於荷蘭鹿特丹，自稱是全球最大的獨立飲料製造商。公司主要為零售商及品牌飲料企業提供飲料生產、裝瓶、倉儲、物流與配送服務，業務涵蓋北美、歐洲及澳洲，目前在全球擁有85座生產設施。
在零售通路方面，Refresco 與沃爾瑪 (WMT-US) 及 Aldi 等零售商合作，生產自有品牌飲料；在品牌飲料業務方面，合作對象則包括可口可樂 (KO-US)、百事公司 (PEP-US) 及魔爪飲料 (MNST-US) 等企業。這種同時服務零售商自有品牌與大型飲料品牌的商業模式，使 Refresco 在飲料供應鏈中扮演製造及生產服務商的角色。
根據 Refresco 年報，公司2025年營收接近70億美元，調整後息稅折舊攤銷前獲利(EBITDA)約9.3億美元。這些財務數據將是投資人評估潛在上市估值的重要依據。
市場可比較的企業之一，是總部位於美國北卡羅來納州的 Coca-Cola Consolidated (COKE-US)。該公司主要從事可口可樂產品相關業務，與 Refresco 的營運模式並不完全相同，但知情人士認為，仍可作為評估 Refresco 估值的參考對象。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團(LSEG)的數據，Coca-Cola Consolidated 市值約125億美元，企業估值相當於接近12倍 EBITDA。投資人可藉此衡量飲料製造與供應鏈服務企業的市場估值，但不同公司的品牌組合、客戶結構及獲利模式仍可能造成估值差異。
Refresco 考慮上市之際，美國 IPO 市場今年初表現強勁。Dealogic 數據顯示，截至10月8日，2026年美國傳統 IPO 籌資金額已接近1,400億美元，市場原本預期全年有機會接近2021年的歷史高峰。
然而，近期市場波動加劇、債券殖利率走高、升息疑慮升溫，以及投資人對人工智慧支出與相關企業估值的質疑，都可能打亂原先預期熱絡的秋季 IPO 市場。對 Refresco 而言，即使企業營運規模與獲利能力具備一定基礎，最終能否以超過100億美元的估值上市，仍將受到資本市場環境及投資人對估值的接受程度影響。
paras_en: Dutch beverage manufacturer Refresco is reportedly evaluating an initial public offering (IPO) plan, with a target valuation that could exceed $10 billion. Sources say Refresco and its private‑equity owner KKR have recently heard proposals from several investment banks and are assessing the banks' potential underwriting roles, while considering the United States or Europe as possible listing venues.

Sources indicate that if the listing proceeds smoothly, Refresco’s market valuation could surpass $10 billion. However, the planning is still in an early stage and may be adjusted later. Both Refresco and KKR declined to comment on the matter.

KKR acquired Refresco in 2022 through its global infrastructure investment strategy for roughly $8 billion. The strategy focuses on key infrastructure assets, with other investments in utilities, energy and communications services. If Refresco eventually lists at a valuation above $10 billion, it would be higher than KKR’s purchase price, though the actual valuation will depend on market conditions, investor demand and listing terms.

Refresco was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. It describes itself as the world’s largest independent beverage manufacturer. The company primarily provides production, bottling, warehousing, logistics and distribution services to retailers and branded‑beverage companies, operating across North America, Europe and Australia with 85 production facilities worldwide.

In the retail channel, Refresco partners with retailers such as Walmart and Aldi to produce private‑label drinks; on the branded side, it works with companies including Coca‑Cola, PepsiCo and Monster Beverage. This dual model of serving both retailer own‑brands and major beverage brands positions Refresco as a manufacturing and production service provider within the beverage supply chain.

According to Refresco’s annual report, the company’s 2025 revenue is projected to be close to $7 billion, with adjusted EBITDA of about $930 million. These financial figures will be key inputs for investors assessing a potential listing valuation.

One comparable public company is Coca‑Cola Consolidated, based in North Carolina, USA. While its business model differs from Refresco’s, insiders say it can still serve as a reference point for valuing Refresco.

LSEG data shows Coca‑Cola Consolidated has a market capitalization of roughly $12.5 billion, implying an enterprise value of about 12 times EBITDA. Investors can use this multiple to gauge valuations for beverage manufacturing and supply‑chain service firms, though differences in brand portfolios, customer bases and profit models can lead to valuation gaps.

Refresco’s listing considerations come as the U.S. IPO market has been strong early this year. Dealogic data indicates that as of October 8, 2026, U.S. traditional IPO proceeds have approached $140 billion, with expectations that the full‑year total could near the historic peak of 2021.

Nevertheless, heightened market volatility, rising bond yields, mounting rate‑hike concerns, and investor scepticism about AI‑related spending and valuations could disrupt the anticipated lively autumn IPO season. For Refresco, even with solid operational scale and profitability, achieving a valuation above $10 billion will ultimately depend on capital‑market conditions and investor appetite for the price.

items.title: OpenAI營收消息震撼AI產業  較先前報導低200億美元
items.title_en: OpenAI Revenue News Shocks AI Industry, $20 Billion Lower Than Earlier Reports
paras: 《金融時報》(Financial Times) 週四 (8日) 率先引述與投資人分享的財務文件披露，截至 9 月，OpenAI 年化營收約為 500 億美元，低於先前部分媒體報導的約 700 億美元。截稿前，OpenAI 拒絕置評。
知情人士指出，先前較高的數字，源於投資人試圖直接比較 OpenAI 與 Anthropic 的營收規模。Anthropic 將透過亞馬遜 AWS、Google Cloud 等雲端合作夥伴產生的銷售收入計入營收，OpenAI 則未採用相同方式。
投資人先前調整 OpenAI 的營收計算，估算其 8 月年化營收達到 400 億美元，之後再結合公司向投資人披露的營收成長超過 70% 資訊，推算出約 700 億美元的規模。
年化營收規模有時是容易造成誤解的銷售指標，通常以單月營收乘以 12 計算，並非實際全年營收。不過，這仍已成為矽谷快速成長新創公司普遍採用的熱門指標。
由於OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兩家公司計算方式不同，相關數字也不能直接視為相同基準下的比較。
依報導列出的數字，OpenAI 年化營收接近 500 億美元，低於 Anthropic 約 650 億美元的規模。
兩家公司正積極爭取企業客戶，推出程式設計及通用型 AI 代理產品。OpenAI 上週舉行年度開發者大會，發布面向企業工作者的 Dots AI 代理，以及最新模型 GPT-6.1 Sol。
市場也持續關注兩家公司的上市計畫。OpenAI 預期可能於 2027 年初啟動首次公開發行 (IPO)，Anthropic 則傳出可能在今年感恩節前上市，公開版 S-1 招股文件有望近期公布，惟相關時程仍未正式確認。
paras_en: Financial Times reported on Thursday (the 8th) that, citing financial documents shared with investors, OpenAI’s annualized revenue as of September was about $50 billion, lower than the roughly $70 billion reported by some media earlier. OpenAI declined to comment before the deadline.

Sources said the higher earlier figure stemmed from investors trying to compare OpenAI directly with Anthropic’s revenue. Anthropic counts sales revenue generated through cloud partners such as Amazon AWS and Google Cloud, whereas OpenAI does not use the same method.

Investors had previously adjusted OpenAI’s revenue calculation, estimating its August annualized revenue at $40 billion, and then combined that with the company’s disclosed revenue growth of over 70% to extrapolate a size of about $70 billion.

Annualized revenue can be a misleading sales metric, usually calculated by multiplying a single month’s revenue by 12 rather than reflecting actual full‑year revenue. Nonetheless, it has become a popular metric among fast‑growing Silicon Valley startups.
Because OpenAI and Anthropic use different calculation methods, the figures cannot be directly compared on the same basis.
Based on the numbers reported, OpenAI’s annualized revenue is close to $50 billion, lower than Anthropic’s roughly $65 billion scale.

Both companies are actively courting enterprise customers, launching programming and general‑purpose AI agent products. OpenAI held its annual developer conference last week, unveiling the Dots AI agent for business users and the latest model GPT‑6.1 Sol.

The market continues to watch the two firms’ IPO plans. OpenAI may launch its IPO in early 2027, while Anthropic is rumored to go public before this year’s Thanksgiving, with a public S‑1 expected soon, though timelines are not officially confirmed.

items.title: 美光、SK海力士跌5%記憶體股倒一片 三星財測不如預期
items.title_en: Micron, SK Hynix Drop 5% as Memory Stocks Plunge; Samsung Forecast Misses Expectations
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，今年最熱門的AI交易之一，周四(8日)遭遇打擊。
記憶體與資料儲存類股走跌，此前三星電子(Samsung Electronics)公布的初步財測低於市場預期。
全球最大記憶體晶片製造商三星表示，預計第三季營收約為195兆韓元(1,450.6億美元)，營業利益約107.4兆韓元(798.9億美元)。根據Visible Alpha估計，分析師原本預期營收將達205.26兆韓元，營業利益為112.73兆韓元。
在消息公布後，SanDisk(SNDK-US)周四下跌4.9%，SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)大跌5%，希捷科技(Seagate Technology)(STX-US)下跌4.05%，美光(Micron)(MU-US)則下跌4.8%。Roundhill記憶體ETF(DRAM-US)下跌5.13%。三星電子在韓國交易所股價則下跌2.4%。
包括美光與SanDisk在內，多檔相關股票今年以來一直是標普500指數表現最強勁股票之一。AI需求蓬勃發展，推動這些公司的營收與獲利創下新高，但近期投資人開始質疑這波成長是否能夠持續。
分析師也警告，在市場已經抱持高度期待的情況下，記憶體類股這些漲幅驚人的股票，可能越來越難持續帶給投資人驚喜。
Coin Bureau分析師Nic Puckrin表示，「三星仍明顯維持驚人的成長，但如今龐大的數字已經無法再讓投資人感到驚艷。」
他指出，投資人可能正關注三星單季獲利成長速度放緩，並思考一旦記憶體晶片製造商在未來幾年提高供給，晶片價格將會出現什麼變化。
三星預計將於本月稍晚10月29日公布完整財報。
paras_en: Investopedia reported that one of the hottest AI trades of the year took a hit on Thursday (the 8th).
Memory and data storage stocks fell after Samsung Electronics released preliminary financial forecasts that fell short of market expectations.

The world’s largest memory chip manufacturer, Samsung, said it expects third‑quarter revenue of about 195 trillion won (US$145.06 billion) and operating profit of about 107.4 trillion won (US$79.89 billion). According to Visible Alpha estimates, analysts had originally expected revenue of 205.26 trillion won and operating profit of 112.73 trillion won.

After the announcement, SanDisk (SNDK‑US) fell 4.9% on Thursday, SK Hynix (SKHY‑US) plunged 5%, Seagate Technology (STX‑US) dropped 4.05%, and Micron (MU‑US) fell 4.8%. The Roundhill Memory ETF (DRAM‑US) fell 5.13%, and Samsung Electronics’ share price on the Korean exchange fell 2.4%.

Including Micron and SanDisk, several related stocks have been among the strongest performers in the S&P 500 this year. The booming AI demand has driven these companies’ revenues and profits to new highs, but investors are beginning to question whether this growth can be sustained.
Analysts also warned that, given the high expectations already in the market, these spectacularly rising memory stocks may increasingly struggle to continue delivering surprises to investors.
Coin Bureau analyst Nic Puckrin said, “Samsung still clearly maintains impressive growth, but the massive numbers can no longer astonish investors.”

He pointed out that investors may be focusing on Samsung’s slowing quarterly profit growth rate and considering what will happen to chip prices if memory chip manufacturers increase supply in the coming years.
Samsung plans to release its full financial report later this month on October 29.

items.title: 2027年科技股買什麼？華爾街大多頭Dan Ives點名這五檔
items.title_en: What Tech Stocks to Buy in 2027? Wall Street Bull Dan Ives Names These Five
paras: 長期看好科技與AI龍頭股的華爾街明星分析師艾夫斯（Dan Ives），公布了布局2027年的科技股首選。
艾夫斯在社群平台X發文，點名輝達(NVDA-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、Palantir(PLTR-US) 、蘋果(AAPL-US) 與蘋果(AAPL-US) 為布局2027年的首選科技股。
他指出，投資人低估了未來幾年這波4兆美元支出浪潮的規模與涵蓋範圍。
艾夫斯點名的這些名字並不陌生，因為他過去在韋德布希證券（Wedbush Securities）任職的8年間，就曾推薦這些公司。他當時擔任全球科技研究主管。
艾夫斯率領的團隊在最新發布的研究報告中表示：「AI革命在這個階段的發展，取決於供給，而非需求。我們認為，AI建設仍處於初期，對未來幾年科技贏家的前景持續高度樂觀。」
團隊指出，AI題材已不再只涉及單一產業，而是牽動「整體經濟的資本、電力與政策」。
艾夫斯最新看法出爐之際，「科技七巨頭」正從今年稍早的低迷中回升。這些股票周二(6日)助推標普500指數創下8月13日以來首度新高，Roundhill科技七巨頭ETF與那斯達克綜合指數則連續第二個交易日刷新收盤紀錄。
科技七巨頭包括Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 、蘋果(AAPL-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 、Meta平台(META-US) 及特斯拉(TSLA-US) 。
艾夫斯及其團隊首次將49檔科技股納入研究範圍，其中Alphabet與蘋果的目標價均為每股400美元，亞馬遜為300美元、Meta為900美元、微軟為615美元、輝達為300美元、特斯拉為500美元，SpaceX則為225美元，上述股票均獲評「優於大盤」。
團隊預期，AI基礎設施的供給限制將「至少延續至2027年」，掌握稀缺算力、記憶體與電力的企業已開始受惠成長。企業軟體已經復甦，資安在資訊科技（IT）預算中的占比將持續提高，實體AI則成為最新發展領域。
軟銀也獲首次給予「優於大盤」評等，目標價為每股290美元；資安業者Crowdstrike(CRWD-US) 同樣獲評「優於大盤」，目標價為335美元。
艾夫斯是知名度最高、也最樂觀看待科技股的分析師之一，去年還推出色彩鮮明的服飾品牌。
他在2023年稱輝達執行長黃仁勳為「AI教父」，並以足球明星梅西為喻，稱Palantir為「AI界的梅西」。此後，這兩家公司的股價均大幅飆升。
在艾夫斯2026年推薦的股票中，CrowdStrike表現最佳，在市場擔憂AI模型能力過於強大的背景下，股價大漲138%。
其他股票的表現則反映出，科技股與AI投資今年走勢分歧、挑戰重重：蘋果上漲22%、微軟上漲9%、Palantir上漲8%，特斯拉下跌15%；輝達今年則上漲28%。
艾夫斯上月推出封閉式基金Ives Ultra AI Opportunities(IVAI-US) ，投資處於後期發展階段、尚未上市的AI與AI基礎設施公司。
此外，他名下還有兩檔ETF，分別是2025年推出的Dan IVES Wedbush AI Revolution ETF(IVES-US) ，以及今年稍早掛牌的Dan IVES Wedbush AI Power & Infrastructure ETF(IVEP-US) 。
paras_en: Long‑term bullish on technology and AI leaders, Wall Street star analyst Dan Ives announced his top picks for tech stocks to position for 2027.
Ives posted on X, naming Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Palantir (PLTR‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US) and Apple (AAPL‑US) as his preferred tech stocks for 2027.
He said investors are underestimating the scale and scope of the upcoming $4 trillion spending wave over the next few years.
The names Ives highlighted are familiar, as during his eight‑year tenure at Wedbush Securities he repeatedly recommended these companies while serving as global head of technology research.

Ives’s team wrote in a newly released research report: “The AI revolution at this stage is driven by supply, not demand. We believe AI construction is still in its early phase and remain highly optimistic about the outlook for technology winners in the coming years.”
The team noted that AI themes now touch the entire economy’s capital, power and policy, no longer confined to a single industry.

As Ives’s latest view came out, the “Big Seven” tech stocks were rebounding from earlier this year’s slump. On Tuesday the 6th, those shares helped lift the S&P 500 to its first new high since August 13, while the Roundhill Tech Seven ETF and the Nasdaq Composite posted a second consecutive day of record closing levels.
The Big Seven comprise Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Apple (AAPL‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Tesla (TSLA‑US).

Ives and his team included 49 tech stocks in their coverage for the first time, assigning target prices of $400 per share for both Alphabet and Apple, $300 for Amazon, $900 for Meta, $615 for Microsoft, $300 for Nvidia, $500 for Tesla, and $225 for SpaceX, with all of these stocks rated “outperform.”

The team expects supply constraints on AI infrastructure to “last at least until 2027,” and companies that control scarce compute, memory and power are already beginning to benefit. Enterprise software is recovering, cybersecurity’s share of IT budgets will keep rising, and physical AI is emerging as the newest growth area.
SoftBank also received an “outperform” rating for the first time, with a target price of $290 per share; cybersecurity firm CrowdStrike (CRWD‑US) was likewise rated “outperform” with a $335 target.
Ives is one of the most well‑known and optimistic tech‑stock analysts, and last year he even launched a brightly colored apparel brand.
In 2023 he called Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang the “AI godfather,” likening Palantir to soccer star Messi as the “Messi of AI,” after which both stocks surged dramatically.
Among the stocks Ives recommended in 2026, CrowdStrike performed best, jumping 138% as markets worried about overly powerful AI models.
The performance of other stocks reflected a divergent and challenging year for tech and AI investments: Apple rose 22%, Microsoft 9%, Palantir 8%, Tesla fell 15%, while Nvidia gained 28% this year.
Last month Ives launched the closed‑end fund Ives Ultra AI Opportunities (IVAI‑US), investing in late‑stage, pre‑IPO AI and AI‑infrastructure companies.
He also manages two ETFs: the Dan Ives Wedbush AI Revolution ETF (IVES‑US) launched in 2025, and the Dan Ives Wedbush AI Power & Infrastructure ETF (IVEP‑US) that listed earlier this year.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走弱 歐洲公債殖利率自高點回落
items.title_en: <NY Forex> Dollar Weakens, European Government Bond Yields Retreat from Peaks
paras: 美元周四(8日)走弱，歐元區公債殖利率的升勢暫歇，而市場對聯準會(Fed)今年利率走向的預期大致維持不變。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報102.17，此前一度升至102.46。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.1204美元，盤中一度跌至1.1171美元。
歐元區政府公債殖利率再度大幅上升，油價飆漲加劇通膨疑慮，投資人持續拋售法國、義大利等高負債國家的公債。
不過，隨著殖利率升勢逐漸降溫，歐元也從盤中低點回升。法國10年期公債殖利率上升2.7個基點至4.8873%，盤中一度攀升至4.9685%。
在投資人密切檢視法國的債務規模、預算赤字，以及2027年總統大選前的政治前景之際，法國受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
西班牙方面，工會周三宣布將於11月11日發動全國性總罷工，抗議住宅問題，而這場示威距離提前舉行的大選僅剩數周。
Fed釋放升息謹慎訊號
市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍偏低。聯準會周三公布最新一次會議紀要後，顯示決策官員認為通膨是經濟展望面臨的最大風險，分析師則表示，會議紀要並未帶來意外訊號。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，為了讓通膨降至聯準會2%的目標，未來可能仍需要進一步升息，但他也表示升息步調具「彈性」，並為即將舉行的10月會議暫停升息留下空間。
華勒的言論呼應了部分聯準會官員上周的說法，他們均釋放出希望在進一步升息上保持耐心的訊號。
SimCorp多資產投資決策研究主管Christoph Schon表示，「多數其他貨幣似乎都與其貨幣政策預期呈反向關係，但那是因為過去一切都受到美元和聯準會主導，而這種情況在過去幾周仍持續存在。」
「有趣的是，現在還有另一個影響歐元的因素，也就是法國、如今甚至西班牙的政治危機……因此，這是一段短暫的時期，焦點不在利率差或貨幣政策，而是一場非常特殊的歐元危機，而在這個案例中，它正影響歐元。」
市場押注12月升息
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會本月升息至少25個基點的機率僅17.2%，略低於一周前的24.4%。不過，投資人押注12月會議升息的機率則達到81.2%。
在華勒發表上述評論後，高盛分析師在報告中表示，他們仍預期聯準會12月將再升息25個基點，並下調12月不升息的機率，因為華勒的言論代表政策立場轉向更加鷹派。
在更為鷹派的談話中，聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩林(Alberto Musalem)表示，美國央行需要再次升息，才能讓通膨回到2%的目標。
經濟數據方面，美國勞工部表示，上周初領失業金人數減少2,000人至19.7萬人，略低於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的20萬人。最新數據持續顯示美國就業市場保持穩定。
歐元區通膨可能高於目前已經偏高的預測，但歐洲央行(ECB)決策官員壓低了市場對短期升息的押注，多名官員周四表示，從基本面趨勢來看，情況其實較為溫和。
德國公債與法國、義大利等歐元區高負債國家公債之間不斷擴大的殖利率差距，已推動歐元跌至2024年5月以來最低水準。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.07%至1.3219美元，此前英國央行(BoE)總裁Andrew Bailey表示，全球債券市場受到高額借貸與不斷升高的通膨壓力衝擊之際，各國政府需要加倍努力，展現修復公共財政的能力。
美元兌日元下跌0.12%至157.88日元。日本銀行(BoJ)表示，原物料成本上升所帶動的價格漲勢正蔓延至消費品，部分企業提高價格的頻率也有所增加，顯示日銀對通膨壓力擴大的情況感到擔憂。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Thursday (the 8th), pausing the rise in Eurozone government bond yields, while market expectations for the Fed's rate path this year remained largely unchanged.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.08% to 102.17 after briefly climbing to 102.46.
The euro rose 0.08% against the dollar to $1.1204, after dipping intraday to $1.1171.
Eurozone sovereign yields surged again as oil price spikes heightened inflation concerns, prompting investors to continue selling bonds of heavily indebted countries such as France and Italy.
However, as the yield rally cooled, the euro recovered from its intraday low. France's 10‑year yield rose 2.7 basis points to 4.8873%, briefly reaching 4.9685% during the session.
The impact on France was especially pronounced as investors closely examined its debt size, budget deficit, and political outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
In Spain, unions announced on Wednesday a nationwide general strike on November 11 to protest housing issues, a protest taking place only weeks before an early election.
Fed signals cautious rate‑hike stance

Market expectations for a rate hike at the Fed's later policy meeting this month remain low. After the Fed released minutes of its latest meeting on Wednesday, officials said inflation remains the biggest risk to the economic outlook, and analysts said the minutes offered no surprise signals.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that further rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target, but he also noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible,” leaving room to pause at the upcoming October meeting.
Waller's comments echoed remarks from other Fed officials last week, who all signaled a desire to be patient on any further tightening.

Christoph Schon, head of multi‑asset investment decision research at SimCorp, said, “Most other currencies seem to move opposite to their monetary‑policy expectations, but that’s because everything has been dominated by the dollar and the Fed, and that situation has persisted over the past few weeks.”

“Interestingly, there is now another factor affecting the euro – the political crises in France and now even Spain… So this is a short‑term episode where the focus is not on rate differentials or policy, but on a very specific euro crisis that is currently influencing the currency,” he added.
Markets bet on a December hike

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 17.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points this month, down slightly from 24.4% a week ago. However, investors see an 81.2% chance of a hike at the December meeting.

After Waller’s remarks, a Goldman Sachs analyst wrote that they still expect a 25‑basis‑point hike in December and lowered the probability of no hike, interpreting Waller’s comments as a shift toward a more hawkish stance.
In an even more hawkish tone, Alberto Musalem, president of St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank, said the U.S. central bank needs another rate increase to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

On the data front, the U.S. Labor Department reported that initial unemployment claims fell by 2,000 to 197,000 last week, slightly below the Reuters poll forecast of 200,000, indicating the labor market remains stable.

Eurozone inflation may be higher than already elevated forecasts, but ECB policymakers have dampened market bets on a near‑term hike, with several officials on Thursday noting that, based on fundamentals, the situation is actually fairly moderate.
The widening yield gap between German bonds and those of high‑debt Eurozone members such as France and Italy has pushed the euro down to its lowest level since May 2024.

The pound rose 0.07% to $1.3219 after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that as global bond markets face high borrowing and rising inflation pressures, governments need to work harder to demonstrate fiscal repair capability.

The dollar fell 0.12% to ¥157.88. The Bank of Japan said rising raw‑material costs are feeding price increases into consumer goods, with some firms raising prices more frequently, showing the BOJ’s concern over expanding inflation pressures.
